investigation.Name: BLOOD SUGAR ( FASTING )
investigation.Description: GLUCOSE IS FORMED FROM CARBOHYDRATE DIGESTION & CONVERSION OF GLYCOGEN TO GLUCOSE BY THE LIVER. THE TWO HORMONES THAT DIRECTLY REGULATE BLOOD GLUCOSE LEVELS ARE GLUCAGON & INSULIN. GLUCAGON ACCELERATES GLYCOGEN BREAKDOWN IN THE LIVER & CAUSES THE BLOOD GLUCOSE LEVELS TO RISE. INSULIN INCREAES CELL MEMBRANE PERMEABILITY TO GLUCOSE, TRANSPORT GLUCOSE INTO CELLS, STIMULATES GLYCOGEN FORMATION, & REDUCE BLOOD GLUCOSE LEVELS.0
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : DIABETES MALLITUS, CUSHING SYNDROME, AC. EMOTIONAL OR STRESS SITUATION, PHEOCHROMOCYTOMA, ACROMEGALY, GIGANTISM, PITUITARY ADENOMA, HEMOCHROMATOSIS, PANCREATITIS, GLUCAGONOMA, ADVANCED LIVER DISEASE, CHR. RENAL DISEASE, WERNICKES ENCEPHALOPATHY.

DECREASED : PANCREATIC ISLET CELL CARCINOMA, EXTRAPANCREATIC STOMACH TUMORS, ADDISON DISEASE, , HYPOPITUITARISM, HYPOTHYROIDISM, ACTH DEFICIENCY, STARVATION,LIVER DAMAGE ( ALCOHOLISM, ARSENIC POISONING, CHLOROFORM POISONING), PREMATURE INFANTS, ENZYME DEFICIENCY DISEASES ( GALACTOSEMIA, INHERITED MAPLE SYRUP DISEASE, VON GIERKES SYNDROME), INSULIN OVERDOSE, REACTIVE HYPOGLYCEMIA.

investigation.Name: TLC
investigation.Description:
THE ENDOCRINE SYSTEM IS AN IMPORTANT REGULATOR OF THE NUMBER OF LEUKOCYTES IN THE BLOOD. HORMONES AFFECT THE PRODUCTION OF LEUKOCYTES IN THE BLOOD FORMING ORGANS, THEIR STORAGE & RELEASE FROM THE TISSUE & THEIR DISINTEGRATION. A LOCAL INFLAMMATORY PROCESS EXERTS A DEFINITE CHEMICAL EFFECT ON THE MOBILIZATION OF LEUKOCYTES. THE LIFE SPAN OF LEUKOCYTES VARIES FROM 13 - 20 DAYS. LEUKOCYTES FIGHT INFECTION & PRODUCE, TRANSPORT & DISTRIBUTE ANTIBODIES AS PART OF THE IMMUNE RESPONSE TO A FOREIGN SUBSTANCE ( ANTIGEN ).
THE WBC SERVE A USEFUL GUIDE TO THE SEVERITY OF THE DISEASE PROCESS.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Leukemoid reaction, acute inflammation, hodgkin's disease, pregnancy, liver disease, TRAUMA OR SURGERY, MALIGNANT NEOPLASM, TOXINS, UREMIA, DRUGS LIKE ETHER, CHLOROFORM, QUININE, ADRENALINE.

DECREASED : VIRAL INFECTIONS, HYPERSPLENISM, OVERWHELMING BACTERIAL INFECTIONS, BONE MARROW DEPRESSION, APLASTIC ANAEMIA ETC.

investigation.Name: HB %
investigation.Description: HB, THE MAIN COMPONENT OF RBC SERVES AS THE VEHICLE FOR THE TRANSPORTATION OF OXYGEN & CARBONDIOXIDE. IT IS COMPOSED OF AMINO ACIDS THAT FORM A SINGLE PROTEIN CALLED GLOBIN & A COMPOUND CALLED HAEM, WHICH CONTAINS IRON ATOMS & RED PIGMENT PORPHYRIN. IT IS THE IRON PIGMENT THAT COMBINES READILY WITH OXYGEN & GIVES BLOOD ITS CHARACTERISTIC RED COLOR. THE OXYGEN COMBINING CAPACITY OF THE BLOOD IS DIRECTLY PROPORTIONAL TO THE HB CONCENTRATION RATHER THAN TO THE RBC BECAUSE SOME RBCS CONTAIN MORE HB THAN OTHERS.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : POLYCYTHEMIA VERA, CHRONIC BRONCHITIS WITH EMPHYSEMA
DECREASED : ANAEMIA

NORMAL VALUES :
0 - 2 WKS : 14.5 - 24.5 GM / ML
2 - 8 WKS : 12.5 - 20.5 
2 - 6 MTHS : 10.7 - 17.3
6 MTHS  - 1 YR : 9.9 - 14.5 
1 - 6 YRS : 9.5 - 14.1 
6 - 16 YRS : 10.3 - 14.9
16 - 18 YRS : 11.1 - 15.7

investigation.Name: DLC
investigation.Description: THE DIFFERENTIAL COUNT IS EXPRESSED AS A PERCENTAGE OF TOTAL NUMBER OF LEUKOCUTES. THE DIFFERENTIAL COUNT ALONE HAS LIMITED VALUE; IT MUST ALWAYS BE INTERPRETED IN RELATION TO TOTAL WBC COUNT.

investigation.Name: ABSOLUTE EOSINOPHIL COUNT
investigation.Description:
EOSINOPHILS CAPABLE OF PHAGOCYTOSIS, INGEST ANTIGEN-ANTIBODY COMPLEXES & BECOME ACTIVE IN THE LATER STAGES OF INFECTION. EOSINOPHILS RESPOND TO ALLERGIC AND PARASITIC DISEASES. EOSINOPHIL GRANULES CONTAIN HISTAMINE( 1/3 OF ALL HISTAMINE IN THE BODY). 
THIS TEST IS USED TO DIAGNOSE ALLERGIC INFECTIONS, ASSESS SEVERITY OF INFESTATIONS WITH WORMS AND OTHER PARASITES & MONITOR RESPONSE TO THEM.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED - ALLERGIES, HAY FEVER, ASTHMA, PARASITIC DISEASES, SOME ENDOCRINE DISORDERS LIKE ADDISONS DISEASE, HYPOPITUITARISM, HODGKINS DISEASE, MYELOPROLIFERATIVE DISORDERS, CHR. MYELOID LEUKEMIA, POLYCYTHEMIA VERA, CHR. SKIN DISEASES LIKE PAMPHIGUS, ECZEMA, DERMATITIS HERPATIFORMIS, SYSTEMIC EOSINOPHELIA, SCARLET FEVER, CHOREA, CONVALSCENT STAGE OF OTHER INFECTIONS, FAMILIAL EOSINOPHELIA, HYPEREOSINOPHELIC SYNDROME, POLYARTERITIS NODOSA, SLE, CONNECTIVE TISSUE DISORDERS, ULCERATIVE COLITIS, CROHNS DISEASE, ALLERGIC DRUG REACTIONS, LOFFLERS SYNDROME, INSECT BITES & IDIOPATHIC.
REDUCED IN : IS USUALLY CAUSED BY AN INCREASED ADRENAL STEROID PRODUCTION THAT ACCOMPANIES MOST CONDITIONS OF BODILY STRESS & IS ASSOCIATED WITH - CUSHING SYNDROME, AC. BACTERIAL INFECTIONS & USE OF CERTAIN DRUGS SUCH AS ACTH, EPINEPHRINE, THYROXINE, PROSTAGLANDINS.

investigation.Name: ESR
investigation.Description:
SEDIMENTATION OCCURS WHEN ERYTHROCYTES CLUMP TOGATHER IN A COLUMN LIKE MANNER. THESE CHANGES ARE RELATED TO ALTERATION IN PLASMA PROTEINS. NORMALLY ERYTHROCYTES SETTLE SLOWLY BECAUSE NORMAL RBCS DO NOT FORM ROULEAUX.
THE ESR IS THE RATE AT WHICH ERYTHROCYTES SETTLE OUT OF ANTICOAGULATED BLOOD IN 1 HR. THIS TEST IS BASED ON THE FACT THAT INFLAMMATORY & NECROTIC PROCESSES CAUSE AN ALTERATION IN BLOOD PROTEINS, RESULTING IN AGGREGATION OF RBCS, WHICH MAKE THEM HEAVIER & MORE LIKELY TO FALL. ESR IS NOT DIAGNOSTIC OF ANY PARTICULAR DISEASE BUT RATHER IS AN INDICATION THAT A DISEASE PROCESS IS GOING ON IN THE BODY. IT IS ALSO USEFUL IN MONITORING THE PROGRESSION OF THE INFLAMMATORY DISEASE.
investigation.Remarks: Increased : Any type of infection, inflammation, rheumataic fever, endocarditis, neoplasm, AMI.

investigation.Name: BT
investigation.Description:
BLEEDING TIME MEASURES THE PRIMARY PHASE OF HAEMOSTASIS; THE INTERACTION OF PLATELETS WITH THE BLOOD VESSEL WALL & THE FORMATION OF A HEMOSTATIC PLUG. BLEEDING IS THE BEST SINGLE SCREENING TEST FOR PLATELET FUNCTION DISORDERS & IS ONE OF THE PRIMARY SCREENING TEST FOR COAGULATION DISORDERS.
THIS TEST IS OF VALUE IN DETECTING VASCULAR ABNORMALITIES & PLATELET ABNORMALITIES OF DEFICIENCIES. IT IS NOT RECOMMENDED FOR ROUTINE PRESURGICAL WORKUP.
THE TEST IS DONE BY AN AUTOMATED SCALPELWHICH CONTROLS THE DEPTH & LENGTH OF INCISION ( USUALLY 1 MM DEEP & 9 MM LONG ) & A SPHYGMOMANOMETER INFLATED TO 40 MM HG DISTENDS THE CAPILLARY BED OF FOREARM UNIFORMLY. AFTER MAKING THE CUT BY SCALPEL TIME IS NOTED TILL BLEEDING STOPS.
investigation.Remarks: Inceased : Thrombocytopenia (DIC, TTP, ITP), von Willebrant's disease, defective platelet function (NSAIDs such as aspirin), ABNORMALITIES IN THE WALLS OF SMALL BLOOD VESSELS, VASCULAR DISEASE, ADVANCED RENAL FAILURE, SEVERE LIVER DISEASE,LEUKEMIA, OTHER MYELOPROLIFERATIVE DISEASE,SCURVY.

investigation.Name: CT
investigation.Remarks: Increased : Heparin therapy, plasma-clotting factor deficiency (except Factors VII and XIII). (Note : This is not a sensitive test and so is therefore not considered a good screening test.)

investigation.Name: PT
investigation.Description:
PROTHROMBIN IS A PROTEIN PRODUCED BY LIVER FOR CLOTTING OF BLOOD. DURING THE CLOTTING PROCESS PROTHROMBIN IS CONVERTED TO THROMBIN. THE PROTHROMBIN CONTENT OF THE BLOOD IS REDUCED IN PATIENTS WITH LIVER DISEASE.
THE PT IS ONE OF THE FOUR MOST IMPORTANT SCREENING TESTS USED IN DIAGNOSING COAGULATION DEFECTS. IT DIRECTLY MEASURES A POTENTIAL DEFECT IN STAGE II OF THE CLOTTING MECHANISM ( EXTRINSIC COAGULATION SYSTEM ) THROUGH ANALYSIS OF THE CLOTTING ABILITY OF FIVE PLASMA COAGULATION FACTORS ( PROTHROMBIN, FIBRINOGEN , FACTOR V, FACTOR VII & FACTOR X ). IN ADDITION TO SCREENING FOR DEFICIENCY OF PROTHROMBIN, THE PT IS USED TO EVALUATE DISFIBRINOGENEMIA, EVALUATE THE HEPARIN EFFECT & COUMARIN EFFECT, LIVER FAILURE & VITAMIN K DEFICIENCY.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Drugs (sodium warfarin [Coumadin]), vitamin K deficiency, fat malabsorption, liver disease, prolonged use of a tourniquet before drawing a blood sample, DIC, DEFICIENCY OF FACTOR II ( PROTHROMBIN), V, VII, OR FACTOR X, HAEMORRHAGIC DISEASE OF NEWBORN, LIVER DISEASE, ALCOHOLIC HEPATITIS, BILIARY OBSTRUCTION, ZOLLINGER-ELLISON SYNDROME, HYPOFIBRNIGENEMIA, DYSFIBRINOGENEMIA, LUPUS ANTICOAGULANT ( CIRCULATING ANTICOAGULANTS).

CONDITIONS THAT DO NOT AFFECT THE PT INCLUDE :

POLYCYTHEMIA VERA , TANNIN DISEASE , CHRISTMAS DISEASE , HEMOPHILIA A , VON WILLEBRAND DISEASE , PLATELET DISORDERS ( IDIOPATHIC THROMBOCYTOPENIC PURPURA )

investigation.Name: BLOOD UREA
investigation.Description:
UREA FORMS IN THE LIVER & ALONG WITH CO2, CONSTITUTES THE FINAL PRODUCT OF PROTEIN METABOLISM. 
THE TEST FOR BUN, WHICH MEASURES THE NITROGEN PORTION OF UREA, IS USED AS AN INDEX OF GLOMERULAR FUNCTION IN THE PRODUCTION & EXCRETION OF UREA. RAPID PROTEIN CATABOLISM & IMPAIRMENT OF KIDNEY FUNCTION WILL RESULT IN INCREASE BUN LEVELS. IN CHRONIC RENAL DISEASE, THE BUN LEVEL CORRELATES BETTER WITH SYMPTOMS OF UREMIA THAN DOES THE SERUM CREATININE.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Renal failure (including drug-induced from aminoglycosides, NSAIDs), pre-renal azotemia (decreased renal perfusion secondary to CHF, shock, volume depletion), POSTRENAL (obstruction), GI bleeding, stress, drugs (especially aminoglycosides), HIGH PROTEIN DIET.

Decreased : Starvation, liver failure (hepatitis, drugs), pregnanay, infancy, nephrotic syndrome, overhydration.

investigation.Name: SERUM CREATININE
investigation.Description:
CREATININE IS A SUBSTANCE THAT IN HEALTH IS EASILY EXCRETED BY THE KIDNEYS. IT IS THE BY PRODUCT OF MUSCLE ENERGY METABOLISM AND IS PRODUCED AT A CONSTANT RATE ACCORDING TO THE MUSCLE MASS OF THE INDIVIDUAL. ENDOGENOUS CREATININE PRODUCTION IS CONSTANT AS LONG AS THE MUSCLE MASS IS CONSTANT. 
DISORDERS OF KIDNEY FUNCTION PREVENT MAXIMUM EXCRETION OF CREATININE WHICH BECOMES HIGH IN THE BLOOD.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : RENAL FAILURE (PRERENAL, RENAL, OR POSTRENAL OBSTRUCTION OR MEDICATION-INDUCED [AMINOGLYCOSIDES, NSAIDS, OTHERS]), GIGANTISM, ACROMEGALY, INGESTION OF ROASTED MEAT, FALSE-POSITIVE WITH DKA, HYPERTHYROIDISM

DECREASED : PREGNANCY, DECREASED MUSCLE MASS IN DISEASES CHARACTERIZED BY MUSCLE WASTING, SEVERE LIVER DISEASE.

investigation.Name: SERUM URIC ACID
investigation.Description: URIC ACID IS FORMED FROM THE BREAKDOWN OF NUCLEONIC ACID & IS AN END PRODUCT OF PURINE METABOLISM. ELEVATED LEVELS INDICATE HIGHER RISK OF CHD.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : GOUT, RENAL FAILURE, DESTRUCTION OF MASSIVE AMOUNTS OF NUCLEOPROTEINS (LEUKEMIA, ANEMIA, CHEMOTHERAPY, TOXEMIA OF PREGNANCY), DRUGS (ESPECIALLY DIURETICS), LACTIC ACIDOSIS, HYPOTHYROIDISM, PCKD, PARATHYROID DISEASES, ETHANOL CONSUMPTION, DOWN SYNDROME, LEAD POISONING, STARVATION, WEIGHT LOSS DIET, DIABETIC KETOACIDOSIS, LIVER DISEASE, HYPERLIPIDEMIA, HEMOLYTIC ANEMIA, SICKLE CELL ANEMIA, PSORIASIS, GLYCOGEN STORAGE DISEASE, OBESITY, SARCOIDOSIS, IDIOPATHIC & DRUGS LIKE MOST DIURETICS, CATECHOLAMINES, ETHAMBUTOL, PYRAZINAMIDE, SALICYLATES, LARGE DOSES OF NICOTINIC ACID. 

DECREASED : URICOSURIC DRUGS (SALICYLATES, PROBENECID, ALLOPURINOL), WILSON'S DISEASE, FANCONI'S SYNDROME, XANTHINURIA, SOME MALIGNANCIES LIKE HODGKINS DISEASE, MULTIPLE MYELOMA.

investigation.Name: SERUM BILIRUBIN TOTAL
investigation.Description:
BILIRUBIN RESULTS FROM THE BREAKDOWN OF HAEMOGLOBULIN IN THE RBC & IS A BYPRODUCT OF HAEMOLYSIS. IT IS PRODUCED BY THE RETICULOENDOTHELIAL SYSTEM, REMOVED FROM THE SYSTEM BY LIVER, WHICH EXCRETES IT INTO THE BILE. A RISE IN THE SERUM LEVELS OCCUR WHEN THERE IS AN EXCESSIVE DESTRUCTION OF RED CELLS OR WHEN THE LIVER IS UNABLE TO EXCRETE THE NORMAL AMOUNTS OF BILIRUBIN PRODUCED.
THERE ARE TWO FORMS OF BILIRUBIN; DIRECT ( CONJUGATED), WHICH CIRCULATES FREELY IN THE BODY UNTIL IT REACHES THE LIVER WHERE IT IS CONJUGATED WITH GLUCORONIDE TRANSFERASE & THEN EXCRETED INTO THE BILE & INDIRECT( UNCONJUGATED) WHICH IS PROTEIN BOUND.
THE MEASUREMENT OF BILIRUBIN ALLOWS EVALUATION OF LIVER FUNCTION & HAEMOLYTIC ANEMIAS.
investigation.Remarks: INCREASED TOTAL : HEPATIC DAMAGE (HEPATITIS, TOXINS, CIRRHOSIS), BILIARY OBSTRUCTION (STONE OR TUMOR), HEMOLYSIS LIKE IN HEMOLYTIC ANEMIA, SICKLE CELL DISEASE, HEMOLYTIC DISEASE OF NEW BORN, PERNICIOUS ANEMIA OR A TRANFUSION REACTION, IN CASES OF ABNORMAL BILIRUBIN METABOLISM LIKE IN GILBERT DISEASE, ROTORS DISEASE, DUBIN-JOHNSON DISEASE, CRIGER-NAJJAR DISEASE,  FASTING, DRUGS LIKE ANTIPSYCHOTIC DRUGS, SEX HORMONES & MANY OTHER.

investigation.Name: SERUM PROTEIN TOTAL
investigation.Description: SERUM PROTEINS REPRESENT IMMUNOGLOBULINS, CARRIER PROTEINS & OTHER CLASSES OF PROTEINS. THIS TEST CAN DIAGNOSE OR EVALUATE NEPHROTIC SYNDROME, LIVER DISEASE, NUTRITIONAL STATES & OSMOTIC PRESSURES IN EDEMATOUS AND MALNOURISHED PATIENT.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : MULTIPLE MYELOMA, WALDENSTROM'S MACROGLOBULINEMIA, BENIGN MONOCLONAL GAMMOPATHY OF INDETERMINATE SIGNIFICANCE, LYMPHOMA, CHRONIC INFLAMMATORY DISEASE, SARCOIDOSIS, VIRAL ILLNESSES, TROPICAL DISEASE, COLLAGEN DISORDERS LIKE SLE & RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS, CHRONIC INFECTIONS, IN DEHYDRATION & HAEMOCONCENTRATION BECAUSE OF FLUID LOSS.

DECREASED : MALNUTRITION, INFLAMMATORY BOWEL DISEASE, HODGKIN'S DISEASE, LEUKEMIAS, ANY CAUSE OF DECREASED ALBUMIN, SEVERE LIVER DISEASE, ALCOHOLISM, RENAL DISEASE, NEPHROTIC SYNDROME, CROHNS DISEASE, ULCERATIVE COLITIS, SEVERE SKIN DISEASE OR BURN, HEART FAILURE, HYPOTHYROIDISM, PROLONGED IMMOBILIZATION, PREGNANCY

investigation.Name: SERUM ALBUMIN
investigation.Description:
ALBUMINS PRIMARY FUNCTION IS THE MAINTENACE OF COLLOIDAL OSMOTIC PRESSURE IN THE VASCULAR & EXTRAVASCULAR SPACES. ALBUMIN IS A SOURCE OF NUTRITION & ALSO A PART OF A COMPLEX BUFFER SYTEM. IT DECREAES IN RESPONSE TO ACUTE INFLAMMATORY INFECTIOUS PROCESSES
ALBUMIN IS USED TO EVALUATENUTRITIONAL STATUS, ALBUMIN LOSS IN ACUTE ILLNESS, LIVER DISEASE & RENAL DISEASE WITH PROTEINURIA, HAEMORRHAGE, BURNS, EXUDATES OR LEAKS IN THE G.I. TRACT & OTHER CHRONIC DISEASES.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : DEHYDRATION, HAEMOCONCENTRATION.

DECREASED : MALNUTRITION, MALABSORPTION, OVERHYDRATION, NEPHROTIC SYNDROME, THYROTOXICOSIS, CUSHING DISEASE, FAMILIAL HYPOPROTEINEMIA, CHF, MULTIPLE MYELOMA, HODGKIN'S DISEASE, LEUKEMIA, METASTATIC CANCER, PROTEIN-LOSING ENTEROPATHIES, CHRONIC GLOMERULONEPHRITIS, ALCOHOLIC CIRRHOSIS, CHR. LIVER DISEASES, INFLAMMATORY BOWEL DISEASE COLLAGEN-VASCULAR DISEASES, HYPERTHYRODISM, LATE PREGNANCY ( DUE TO HAEMODILUTION).

investigation.Name: SGOT ( AST )
investigation.Description: SGOT OR AST IS AN ENZYME PRESENT IN TISSUES OF HIGH METABOLIC ACTIVITY, DECREASING CONC. OF AST ARE FOUND IN THE HEART, LIVER, SKELETAL MUSLES, KIDNEY, BRAIN, PANCREAS, SPLEEN & LUNGS. THE ENZYME IS RELEASED INTO THE BLOOD FOLLOWING THE INJURY TO THE TISSUES. FOLLOWING ANY SEVERE INJURY THE BLOOD AST LEVEL WILL RISE IN 12 HRS AND REMAIN ELEVATED FOR ABOUT5 DAYS.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : ACUTE MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION, LIVER DISEASE, REYE'S SYNDROME, MUSCLE TRAUMA AND INJECTION, PANCREATITIS, INTESTINAL INJURY OR SURGERY, FACTITIOUS INCREASE (ERYTHROMYCIN, OPIATES), BURNS, CARDIAC CATHETERIZATION, BRAIN DAMAGE, RENAL INFARCTION & DRUG INDUCED

DECREASED : BERIBERI (VITAMIN B6 DEFICIENCY), SEVERE DIABETES WITH KETOACIDOSIS, LIVER DISEASE, CHRONIC HEMODIALYSIS & PREGNANCY

investigation.Name: SGPT ( ALT )
investigation.Description:
AMINOTRANSFERASE ( ALT ) OR GPT IS AN ENZYME WHICH IS FOUND IN HIGH CONCENTRATION IN LIVER & RELATIVELY LOW CONC. IN HEART, MUSCLE & KIDNEYS.
THE TEST IS PRIMARILY DONE TO DIAGNOSE LIVER DISEASE & TO MONITOR COURSE OF TREATMENT FOR HEPATITIS. ALT IS MORE SENSITIVE IN THE DETECTION OF LIVER DISEASE THAN IN BILIARY OBSTRUCTION. ALT ALSO DIFFERENTIATES BETWEEN HAEMOLYTIC JAUNDICE & JAUNDICE DUE TO LIVER DISEASE.
investigation.Remarks: INCREASED : LIVER DISEASE, LIVER METASTASIS, BILIARY OBSTRUCTION, PANCREATITIS, LIVER CONGESTION (ALT IS MORE ELEVATED THAN AST, AST ELEVATED MORE THAN ALT IN ALCOHOLIC HEPATITIS.), VIRAL, INFECTIOUS OR TOXIC HEPATITIS,INFECTIOUS MONONUCLEOSIS, PANCREATITIS, MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION, HEART FAILURE, POLYMYOSITIS, MYOPATHIES, SEVERE BURNS, SEVERE SHOCK, TRAUMA TO STRIATED MUSCLES, PARACETAMOL OVERDOSE OR DRUG INDUCED.

investigation.Name: SERUM ALKALINE PHOSPHATASE
investigation.Description:
ALKALINE PHOSPHATASE IS AN ENZYME ORIGINATING MAINLY IN THE BONES, LIVER & PLACENTA WITH SOME ACTIVITY IN THE KIDNEY & INTESTINES.
ALKALINE PHOSPHATASE IS USED AS INDEX OF LIVER & BONE DISEASES. IN BONE DISEASE, THE ENZYME LEVEL RISES IN PROPORTION TO NEW BONE CELL PRODUCTION RESULTING FROM OSTEOBLASTIC ACTIVITY & THE DEPOSIT OF CALCIUM IN THE BONES. IN LIVER DISEASE, THE BLOOD LEVEL RISES WHEN EXCRETION OF THIS ENZYME IS IMPAIRED AS A RESULT OF OBSTRUCTION IN THE BILIARY TRACT.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : INCREASED CALCIUM DEPOSITION IN BONE (HYPERPARATHYROIDISM), PAGET'S DISEASE, OSTEOBLASTIC BONE TUMORS (METASTATIC OR OSTEOGENIC SARCOMA), INFILTRATIVE BONE DISORDERS, OSTEOMALACIA, RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS, RICKETS, PREGNANCY, CHILDHOOD, HEALING FRACTURE, LIVER DISEASE SUCH AS BILIARY OBSTRUCTION (MASSES, DRUG THERAPY), INTRAHEPATIC CHOLESTASIS, CHRONIC INFLAMMATORY BOWEL DISEASE, HYPERTHYRODISM.
CHILDREN & ADOLESCENTS TYPICALLY HAVE HIGHER BLOOD ALP LEVELS AS THEIR BONES ARE STILL GROWING.

DECREASED : MALNUTRITION, EXCESS VITAMIN D INGESTION.

investigation.Name: S. AMYLASE
investigation.Description:
AMYLASE CHANGES STARCH TO SUGAR & IS PRODUCED BY SALIVARY GLANDS & PANCREAS; MUCH LOWER ACTIVITIES ARE PRESENT IN THE OVARIES, INTESTINES & SKELETAL MUSCLES.
AMYLASE & LIPASE TESTS ARE DONE TO DIAGNOSE & MONITOR TREATMENT OF ACUTE PANCREATITIS & TO DIFFERENTIATE PANCREATITIS FROM OTHER ACUTE ABDOMINAL CONDITIONS.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Acute pancreatitis, pancreatic duct obstruction (stones, stricture, tumor, sphincter spasm secondary to drugs), pancreatic pseudocyst or abscess, alcohol ingestion, mumps, parotiditis, renal disease, macroamylasemia, cholecystitis, peptic ulcers, intestinal obstruction, mesenteric thrombosis, after surgery, INFARCTION, DIABETIC KETOACIDOSIS.

Decreased : Pancreatic destruction (pancreatitis, cystic fibrosis), liver damage (hepatitis, cirrhosis), normal newborns in the first year of life.

investigation.Name: S.LIPASE
investigation.Description:
IT IS A GLYCOPROTEIN THAT IN THE PRESENCE OF BILE SALTS & COLIPASE, CHANGES FATS TO FATTY ACIDS & GLYCEROL. PANCREAS IS THE MAJOR SOURCE OF THIS ENZYME. LIPASE APPEARS IN THE BLOOD FOLLOWING PANCREATIC DAMAGE AT THE SAME TIME AS AMYLASE APPEAR BUT REMAINS ELEVATED MUCH LONGER THAN AMYLASE ( 7-10 DAYS).
AMYLASE & LIPASE TESTS ARE DONE TO DIAGNOSE & MONITOR TREATMENT OF ACUTE PANCREATITIS & TO DIFFERENTIATE PANCREATITIS FROM OTHER ACUTE ABDOMINAL CONDITIONS.
investigation.Remarks: Increased : Acute or chronic pancreatitis, pseudo-cyst, pancreatic duct obstruction (stone, stricture, tumor, drug-induced spasm), fat embolus syndrome, renal failure, dialysis (usually normal in mumps) gastric malignancy, intestinal perforation, diabetes (usually in DKA only), CHOLECYSTITIS, STRAGULATED OR INFARCTED BOWEL, PERITONITIS, PRIMARY BILIARY CIRRHOSIS, CHRONIC RENAL FAILURE

investigation.Name: SERUM CALCIUM
investigation.Description:
INCREASED : HYPERPARATHYROIDISM, VIT D EXCESS, SARCOIDOSIS, MULTIPLE MYELOMA, MALIGNANCY, USE OF THIAZIDE DIURETICS
DECREASED : HYPOPARATHYROIDISM, VIT D DEFICIENCY, RENAL FAILURE, MAGNESIUM DEFICIENCY, HYPOALBUMINURIA
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : (Note : Levels > 12 mg/dL [2.99 mmol/L] may lead to coma and death) Primary hyperparathyroidism, PTH-secreting tumors, vitamin D excess, metastatic bone tumors, osteoporosis, immobilization, milk-alkali syndrome, Paget's disease, idiopathic hypercalcemia of infants, infantile hypophosphatasia, thiazide diuretics, chronic renal failure, sacroidosis, multiple myeloma.

Decreased : (Note Levels <7mg/dL [<1.75 mmol/L] May lead to tetany and death.) Hypoparathyroidism (surgical, idiopathic), pseudo-hypoparathyroidosm, insufficient vitamin-D, calcium and phosphorus ingestion (pregnancy, osteomalacia, rickets), hypomagnesemia, renal tubular acidosis, hypoalbuminemia (cachexia, nephrotic syndrome, CF), chronic renal failure (phosphate retention), acute pancreatitis, factitious decrease because of low protein and albumin.

investigation.Name: SERUM CHOLESTEROL
investigation.Description: IT EVALUATES RISK FOR ATHEROSCLEROSIS & IS IMPORTANT SCREENING TEST FOR HEART DISEASE. CHOLESTROL DETERMINATION IS ALSO FREQUENTLY A PART OF THYROID FUNCTION, LIVER FUNCTION, RENAL FUNCTION & DIABETES MALLITUS STUDIES. IT IS ALSO USED TO MONITOR EFFECTIVENESS OF DIET, MEDICATION, LIFESTYLE CHANGES & STRESS MANAGEMENT.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Idiopathic hypercholesterolemia, biliary obstruction, nephrosis, hypothyroidism, pancreatic disease (diabetes), pregnancy, oral contraceptives, hyperlipoproteinemia (types Iib, III, V), HEPATOCELLULAR DISEASE, BILIARY CIRHOSIS, CHR. RENAL FAILURE, ALCOHOLISM, POORLY CONTROLED DIABETES MALLITUS, HIGH CHOLESTROL DIET, OBESITY.

Decreased : Liver disease (hepatitis, etc), hyperthyroidism, malnutrition (cancer, starvation), chronic anemias, steroid therapy, HYPO-ALPHA-lipoproteinemias, AMI, MENTAL RETARDATION, CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE LUNG DISEASE, SEVERE BURN , INFECTIONS.

investigation.Name: SERUM LIPIDS TOTAL
investigation.Description: LIPOPROTEIN MEASUREMENTS ARE DIAGNOSTIC INDICATORS FOR HYPERLIPIDEMIA & HYPOLIPIDEMIA. LIPIDS ARE FATTY SUBSTANCES MADE UP OF CHOLESTROL, CHOLESTROL ESTERS, TRIGLYCERIDES, NONESTERIZED FATTY ACIDS & PHOSPHOLIPIDS. A LIPID PROFILE USUALLY INCLUDES CHOLESTROL, TRIGLYCERIDES, LDL & HDL LEVELS.

investigation.Name: SERUM SODIUM
investigation.Description: IT IS ONE OF VERY IMPORTANT ELECTROLYTES OF THE BODY WHICH IS ALTERED IN MANY BODY CONDITIONS AND DISEASES.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Associated with low total body sodium (glycosuria, mannitol, or lactulose use urea, excess sweating), normal total body sodium (diabetes insipidus [central and nephrogenic], respiratory losses, and sweating), and increased total body sodium (administration of hypertonic sodium bicarbonate, Cushing's syndrome, hyperaldosteronism).

Decreased : Associated with excess total body sodium and water (nephrotic syndrome, CHF, cirrhosis, renal failure), excess body water (SAIDH, hypothyroidism, adrenal insufficiency), decreased total body water and sodium (diuretic use, renal tubular acidosis, use of mannitol or urea, mineralocorticoid deficiency, vomiting, diarrhea, pancreatitis), and psuedo-hyponatremia (hyperlipidemia, hyperglycemia, and multiple myeloma).
INCREASED : DIABETES INSIPIDUS, DEHYDRATION, HYPERALDOSTERONISM
DECREASED : C.H.F., CIRRHOSIS, USE OF DIURETICS, ADRENAL INSUFFICIENCY, COMPULSIVE WATER DRINKING, INAPPROPRIATE SECRETION OF ADH, OVERHYDRATION

investigation.Name: SERUM POTASSIUM
investigation.Description: IT IS ONE OF THE VERY IMPORTANT ELECTROLYTE OF THE BODY & IS ALTERED IN MANY BODY CONDITIONS AND DISEASES.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : RENAL FAILURE, USE OF POTASSIUM SPARING DIURETICS & ACETYLCHOLINESTERASE INHIBITORS, ADRENAL INSUFFICIENCY, ACIDOSIS
DECREASED : DIARRHOEA, VOMITING, DIURETICS, STEROIDS, NEPHROTIC SYNDROME, DIABETES, CUSHING DISEASE, EXCESSIVE RENIN SEC

investigation.Name: SERUM CHLORIDE
investigation.Description:
INCREASED : RENAL FAILURE, RENAL TUBULAR ACIDOSIS
DECREASED : VOMITING, PYLORIC STENOSIS, OVER TREATMENT WITH DIURETICS
investigation.Remarks:
Increased :  Diarrhoea, renal tubular acidosis, mineralocorticoid deficiency, hyperalimentation, medication (acetazolamide, ammonium chloride)

Decreased : Vomiting, diabetes mellitus with ketoacidosis, mineralocorticoid excess, renal disease with sodium loss.

investigation.Name: CPK ( MALE )
investigation.Description:
CREATINE PHOSPHOKINASE ( CK / CPK ) IS AN ENZYME FOUND IN HIGHER CONCENTRATIONS IN THE HEART & SKELETAL MUSCLES & IN MUCH SMALLER AMOUNT IN BRAIN TISSUE. BECAUSE CK EXISTS IN RELATIVELY FEW ORGANS, THIS TEST IS USED AS A SPECIFIC INDEX OF INJURY TO MYOCARDIUM & MUSCLE.
CPK CAN BE DEVIDED INTO THREE ISOENZYMES; MM OR CK3, BB OR CK1 & MB OR CK2. CK-MM IS THE ISOENZYME THAT CONSTITUTES ALMOST ALL THE CIRCULATORY ENZYMES IN HEALTHY PERSONS. SKELETAL MUSCLE CONTAINS PRIMARILY MM; CARDIAC MUSCLE CONTAINS PRIMARILY MM & MB; AND BRAIN TISSUE, G.I. SYSTEM & GENITOURINARY TRACT CONTAIN PRIMARILY BB. NORMAL CK LEVELS ARE VIRTUALLY 100% MM ISOENZYMES. A SLIGHT INCREASE IN TOTAL CPK LEVEL IF REFLECTED FROM ELEVATED BB , IS FROM BRAIN INJURY.CPK ISOENZYME STUDIES HELP DISTINGUISH WHETHER THE CPK ORIGINATED FROM HEART ( MB ) OR FROM SKELETAL MUSCLE ( MM ).
NEWER TESTS, SUCH AS CK ISOFORMS, ALLOW FOR EARLIER DETECTION OF M.I. THAN IS POSSIBLE WITH CK-MB.
investigation.Remarks: Increased : Muscle damage )AMI, myocarditis, muscular dystrophy, muscle trauma [including injections], after surgery), brain infarction, defibrillation, cardiac catheterization and surgery, rhabdomyolysis, polymyositis, hypothyroidism.

investigation.Name: CPK (MB)
investigation.Description:
CREATINE PHOSPHOKINASE ( CK / CPK ) IS AN ENZYME FOUND IN HIGHER CONCENTRATIONS IN THE HEART & SKELETAL MUSCLES & IN MUCH SMALLER AMOUNT IN BRAIN TISSUE. BECAUSE CK EXISTS IN RELATIVELY FEW ORGANS, THIS TEST IS USED AS A SPECIFIC INDEX OF INJURY TO MYOCARDIUM & MUSCLE.
CPK CAN BE DEVIDED INTO THREE ISOENZYMES; MM OR CK3, BB OR CK1 & MB OR CK2. CK-MM IS THE ISOENZYME THAT CONSTITUTES ALMOST ALL THE CIRCULATORY ENZYMES IN HEALTHY PERSONS. SKELETAL MUSCLE CONTAINS PRIMARILY MM; CARDIAC MUSCLE CONTAINS PRIMARILY MM & MB; AND BRAIN TISSUE, G.I. SYSTEM & GENITOURINARY TRACT CONTAIN PRIMARILY BB. NORMAL CK LEVELS ARE VIRTUALLY 100% MM ISOENZYMES. A SLIGHT INCREASE IN TOTAL CPK LEVEL IF REFLECTED FROM ELEVATED BB , IS FROM BRAIN INJURY.CPK ISOENZYME STUDIES HELP DISTINGUISH WHETHER THE CPK ORIGINATED FROM HEART ( MB ) OR FROM SKELETAL MUSCLE ( MM ).
NEWER TESTS, SUCH AS CK ISOFORMS, ALLOW FOR EARLIER DETECTION OF M.I. THAN IS POSSIBLE WITH CK-MB. IT RISES IN 4-6 HRS, PEAK IN 12 - 24 HRS & LASTS FOR 4 -5 DAYS.
investigation.Remarks: INCREASED : MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION

investigation.Name: SERUM L.D.H.
investigation.Description:
IT IS AN INTRACELLULAR ENZYME WHICH IS WIDELY DISTRIBUTED IN THE TISSUES, PARTICULARLY IN KIDNEYS, HEART, SKELETAL MUSCLES, BRAIN, LIVER & LUNGS.INCREASE IN THE VALUE USUALLY MEANS CELLULAR DEATH & LEKAGE OF THE ENZYME FROM THE CELLS.
ALTHOUGH IT IS NON SPECIFIC BUT IT IS USEFUL IN CONFIRMING MYOCARDIAL OR PULMONARY INFARCTION WHEN VIEWED IN RELATION TO OTHER TEST FINDINGS.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : AC. M.I., PUL. INFARCTION, CHF, CIRRHOSIS LIVER, ALCOHOLISM, AC. VIRAL HEPATITIS, MALIGMNANT NEOPLASMS, LEUKEMIA, LYMPHOMAS, HYPOTHYROIDISM, LUNG IDSEASES, SKELETAL MUSCLE DISEASES, MUSCULAR DAMAGE, MYOPATHIES, MEGALOBLASTIC & PERNICIOUS ANEMIA, HEMOLYTIC ANEMIA, SICKLE CELL ANEMIA, DELIRIUM TREMENS, SEIZURES, SHOCK, HYPOXIA, HYPOTENSION, HYPERTHERMIA, RENAL INFARCTS, CNS DISEASES, AC. PANCREATITIS, FRACTURES & OTHER TRAUMA INCLUDING HEAD, INTESTINAL OBSTRUCTION.

DECREASED : DECREASED LDH LEVELS ARE ASSOCIATED WITH GOOD RESPONSE TO CANCER THERAPY.

investigation.Name: CREATININE CLEARENCE TEST
investigation.Description:
CREATININE IS A SUBSTANCE THAT IN HEALTH IS EASILY EXCRETED BY THE KIDNEYS. IT IS THE BY PRODUCT OF MUSCLE ENERGY METABOLISM AND IS PRODUCED AT A CONSTANT RATE ACCORDING TO THE MUSCLE MASS OF THE INDIVIDUAL. ENDOGENOUS CREATININE PRODUCTION IS CONSTANT AS LONG AS THE MUSCLE MASS IS CONSTANT. 
DISORDERS OF KIDNEY FUNCTION PREVENT MAXIMUM EXCRETION OF CREATININE WHICH BECOMES HIGH IN THE BLOOD. BECAUSE ALL CREATININE FILTERED BY THE KIDNEYS IN A GIVEN TIME INTERVAL IS EXCRETED INTO THE URINE, CREATININE LEVELS ARE EQUIVALENT TO THE GLOMERULAR FILTRATION RATE ( GFR ).
CCT IS PART OF MOST BATTERIES OF QUANITATIVE URINE TESTS. CREATININE CLEARANCE IS MEASURED TOGATHER WITH OTHER URINARY COMPONENTS IN ORDER TO INTERPRET THE OVERALL EXCRETION RATE OF THE VARIOUS URINARY COMPONENTS.
CREATININE CLEARANCE TEST IS A SPECIFIC MEASUREMENT OF KIDNEY FUNCTION, PRIMARILY GLOMERULAR FILTRATION. IT MEASURES THE RATE AT WHICH THE KIDNEYS CLEAR CREATININE FROM THE BLOOD.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : STATE OF HIGH CARDIAC OUTPUT, PREGNANCY, BURNS, CARBON MONOXIDE POISONING.

DECREASED : IT IS FOUND IN ANY CONDITION WHICH DECREASES RENAL BLOOD FLOW LIKE - IMPAIRED KIDNEY FUNCTIONS, INTRINSIC RENAL DISEASE, GLOMERULONEPHRITIS, PYELONEPHRITIS, NEPHROTIC SYNDROME, AC. TUBULAR DYSFUNCTION, AMYLOIDOSIS, INTERSTITIAL NEPHRITIS, SHOCK, HAEMORRHAGE, DEHYDRATION, CHR. OBSTRUCTIVE LUNG DISEASE, CHF.

investigation.Name: GLUCOSE TOLERANCE TEST ( II - 30 MTS )
investigation.Description: IN HEALTHY INDIVIDUALS THE INSULIN RESPONSE TO A LARGE ORAL GLUCOSE DOSE IS ALMOST IMMIDIATE. IT PEAKS IN 30 MTS TO 60 MTS & RETURNS TO NORMAL LIMITS WITHIN 3 HRS WHEN SUFFICIENT INSULIN IS PRESENT OT METABOLISE THE GLUCOSE INGESTED. THE TEST SHOULD BE PERFORMED ACCORDING TO THE WHO GUIDELINES USING GLUCOSE LOAD CONTAINING THE EQUIVALENT OF 75 - 100 GMS OF ANHYDROUS GLUCOSE DISSOLVED IN WATER OR OTHER SOLUTION.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Diabetes mellitus, Cushing's acromegaly, increased epinephrine (injection, pheochromocytoma, stress, burns, etc), acute pancreatitis, ACTH administration, spurious increase caused by drawing blood from a site above an IV line containing dextrose, elderly patients, pancreatic glucagonoma, drugs (glucocorticoids, some diuretics).

Decreased : Pancreatic disorders (pancreatitis, islet cell tumors), extrapancreatic tumors (carcinoma of the adrenals, stomach), hepatic disease (hepatitis, cirrhosis, tumors), endocrine disorders (early diabetes, hypothyroidism, hypopituitarism), functional disorders (after gastrectomy), pediatric problems (prematurity, infant of a diabetic mother, ketotic hypoglycemia, enzyme diseases), exogenous insulin, oral hypoglycemic agents, malnutrition, sepsis.

investigation.Name: SERUM MAGNESIUM
investigation.Description:
MAGNESIUM IN THE BODY IS CONCENTRATED IN BONES, MUSCLE, WITHIN THE CELLS ITSELF & IN THE SERUM. IT IS REQUIRED FOR THE USE OF ADENOSINE TRIPHOSPHATE ( ADP ) AS A SOURCE OF ENERGY. IT IS THEREFORE NECESSARY FOR THE ACTION OF NUMEROUS ENZYME SYSTEMS SUCH AS CARBOHYDRATE METABOLISM, PROTEIN SYNTHESIS, NUCLEIC ACID SYNTHESIS & CONTRACTION OF MUSCLE TISSUE.
MAGNESIUM & CALCIUM ARE INTIMATELY LINKED IN THEIR BODY FUNCTIONS & DEFICIENCY OF EITHER ONE HAS A SIGNIFICANT EFFECT ON THE METABOLISM OF THE OTHER. MAGNESIUM MEASUREMENT IS USED TO EVALUATE RENAL FUNCTION, ELECTROLYTE STATUS & EVALUATE MAGNESIUM METABOLISM.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Renal failure, hypothyroidism, magnesium-containing antacids, Addison's disease, diabetic coma, severe dehydration, lithium intoxication.

Decreased : malabsorption, steatorrhea, alcoholism and cirrhosis, hyperthyroidism, aldosteronism, diuretics, acute pancreatitis, hyperparathyroidism, hyperalimenation, NG suctioning, chronic dialysis, renal tubular acidosis, drugs (cisplatin, amphotericin B, aminoglycosides0, hungry bone syndrome, hypophosphatemia, intracellular shifts with respiratory or metabolic acidosis.

investigation.Name: SERUM IRON ( MALE )
investigation.Description:
TOTAL IRON BINDING CAPACITY ( TIBC ) CORELATES WITH SERUM TRANSFERRIN, BUT THE RELATION IS NOT LINEAR. A SERUM IRON TEST WITHOUT A TIBC AND TRASNSFERRIN DETERMINATION HAS VERY LIMITED VALUE EXCEPT IN CASES OF IRON POISONING. TRANSFERRIN SATURATION IS A BETTER INDEX OF IRON SATURATION; IT IS EVALUATED AS FOLLOWS :
TRANSFERRIN SATURATION % = S. IRON * 100 / TIBC
 THE COMBINED RESULTS OF TRANSFERRIN, IRON & TIBC TESTS ARE HELPFUL IN THE DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSIS OF ANEMIA, IN THE ASSESSMENT OF IRON DEFIICIENCY ANEMIA & IN THE EVALUATION OF THALASSEMIA, SIDEROBLASTIC ANEMIA & HEMOCHROMATOSIS.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : hemochromatosis, hemosiderosis caused by excessive iron intake, excess destruction or decreased production of erythrocytes, liver necrosis, HEMOLYTIC ANEMIA, ESPECIALLY THALASSEMIA, PERNICIOUS ANEMIA IN RELAPSE; IRON OVERLOAD SYNDROME, MULTIPLE TRANSFUSIONS, INAPPROPRIATE IRON THERAPY, VIT B6 DEFICIENCY, LEAD POISONING, AC. LEUKEMIA, NEPHRITIS.

Decreased : Iron deficiency anemia, nephrosis (loss of iron-binding proteins), normochromic anemia of chronic diseases and infections, ACUTE & CHRONIC BLOOD LOSS, LATE PREGNANCY.

investigation.Name: RA FACTOR
investigation.Description:
THE BLOOD OF MANY PERSONS WITH RA CONTAIN A MACROGLOBULIN TYPE ANTIBODY CALLED RHEUMATOID FACTOR. EVIDENCE INDICATES THAT RHEUMATOID FACTORS ARE ANTI-GAMMA-GLOBULIN ANTIBODIES. RF IS SOMETIMES FOUND IN BLOOD SERUM FROM PATIENTS WITH OTHER DISEASES, ALTHOUGH RF INCIDENCE AND VALUES ARE HIGHER IN PATIENTS WITH RA.
THIS TEST IS USEFUL IN DIAGNOSING RA. IT MEASURES RFS ( ANTIBODIES DIRECTED AGAINST THE FC FRAGMENT OF IGG). THESES ARE USUALLY IGM ABTIBODIES, BUT THEY MAY ALSO BE IGG OR IGA.
investigation.Remarks: Increased : Collagen-vascular diseases (RA, SLE, scleroderma, polyarteritis nodosa others), infections (TB, syphilis, viral hepatitis), chronic inflammation, SBE, some lung diseases, MI.

investigation.Name: C-REACTIVE PROTEIN
investigation.Description:
DURING AN INFLAMMATORY PROCESS, THIS ABNORMAL PROTEIN APPEARS IN THE BLOOD. THIS PROTEIN IS VERTUALLY ABSENT FROM THE BLOOD OF HEALTHY PERSONS. CRP IS ONE OF THE MOST SENSITIVE ACUTE PHASE REACTANTS. LEVELS OF CRP CAN INCREASE DRAMATICALLY ( 100 FOLDS OR MORE ) AFTER TRAUMA, BACTERIAL INFECTION, INFLAMMATION, SURGERY OR NEOPLASTIC PROLIFERATION.
MEASUREMENT OF CRP HAS BEEN USED HISTORICALLY TO ASSESS ACTIVITY OF INFLAMMATORY DISEASE, TO DETECT INFECTIONS AFTER SURGERY, TO DETECT TRANSPLANT REJECTION & TO MONITOR THESE INFLAMMATORY PROCESSES. IT IS SEEN HIGH JUST PRIOR TO ACUTE MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION & IS TAKEN AS INDICATOR OF IMPENDING INFARCTION.
investigation.Remarks: Increased: Bacterial infections, inflammatory conditions (acute rheumatic fever, acute R.A. MI, transplant rejection, embolus, inflammatory bowel disease), last half of pregnancy, oral contraceptives, some malignancies.

investigation.Name: ANTI-NUCLEAR ANTIBODY TEST
investigation.Description: MEASUREMENT OF ANA IN THE SERUM IS THE MOST COMMONLY PERFORMED SCREENING TEST FOR AUTOANTIBODIES IN PATIENTS SUSPECTED OF HAVING SYSTEMIC RHEUMATIC DISEAESE( SRD ) ESPECIALLY IF THE TITER IS > 1:160. SRD IS ALSO CALLED AS CONNECTIVE TISSUE OR COLLAGEN DISEASES , WHICH ARE SLE, MIXED CONNECTIVE TISSUE DISEASE, DRUG INDUCED LUPUS LIKE SYNDROME ( PROCAINAMIDE, HYDRALAZINE, ISONIAZID ETC ), SJOGREN SYNDROME, SCLERODERMA, CREST SYNDROME ( CALCINOSIS, RAYNAUDS PHENOMENON, EOSOPHAGEAL DYSFUNCTION, SCLERODACTYLY & TELANGIECTASIA ), RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS, POLYMYOSITIS, DERMATOMYOSITIS.
investigation.Remarks: LOW TITRES ARE PRESENT IN ELDERLY, DRUGS LIKE PROCAINAMIDE, PHENYTOIN, ETHOSUXIMIDE, PRIMIDONE, METHYL DOPA, PENICILLAMINE, CARBAMAZEPINE, THIAZIDE DIURETICS, GRISEOFULVIN, CHLORPROMAZINE, ISONIAZID, QUINIDINE, GOLD SALTS, MINOCYCLINE & HYDRALAZINE. VIRAL ILLNESSES & SOME CHRONIC INFECTIONS MAY CAUSE POSITIVE RESULTS LIKE SLE, RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS, MIXED CONNECTIVE TISSUE DISORDERS,, SJOGRENS SYNDROME, NECROTISING VASCULITIS, TUBERCULOSIS, CHR. ACTIVE HEPATITIS, SABE, HIV INFECTION, TYPE I DIABETES MALLITUS, MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS, PULMONARY FIBROSIS, SILICON GEL IMPLANTS, PREGNANCY.

investigation.Name: SERUM IGA
investigation.Description:
FIVE CLASSES OF IMMUNOGLOBULINS - IGA, IGG, IGM, IGD, IGE, HAVE BEEN ISOLATED. IMMUNOGLOBULINS FUNCTION TO NEUTRALIZE TOXIC SUBSTANCES, SUPPORT PHAGOCYTOSIS, DESTROY MICRO-ORGANISM FUNCTIONS.
IGA TAKES TWO FORMS; SERUM & SECRETORY. SERUM IGA IS PRESENT IN BLOOD SERUM; SECRETORY IGA IS PRESENT IN SALIVA, TEARS, COLOSTRUM & BRONCHIAL, GASTROINTESTINAL & GENITOURINARY SECRETIONS, WHERE IT CAN PROTECT AGAINST MICROORGANISM INVASION. IGA ACCOUNTS FOR 10 - 15% OF TOTAL IMMUNOGLUBULINS.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : CHR. NONALCOHOLIC LIVER DISEASES ESPECIALLY PRIMARY BILIARY CIRRHOSIS, OBSTRUCTIVE JAUNDICE, EXERCISE, ALCOHOLISM, SUBACUTE & CHRONIC INFECTIONS.

DECREAES : ATAXIA TELANGIECTASIA, CHR. SINOPULMONARY DISEASE,CONGENITAL DEFICIT, LATE PREGNANCY, PROLONGED EXPOSURE TO BENZENE IMMUNOSUPPRESSIVE THERAPY, ABSTINENCE FROM ALCOHOL AFTER A PERIOD OF 1 YR., DRUGS & DEXTRIN & PROTEIN LOSING GASTROENTEROPATHIES.

investigation.Name: WIDAL TEST
investigation.Description: DONE TO RULE OUT OR DIAGNOSE TYPHOID OR PARATYPHOID FEVER. IT GENERALLY BECOMES POSITIVE FROM 5 - 7 DAYS OF THE FEVER. THE TITRE MORE THAN 1/160 IN THE ABSENCE OF RECENT IMMUNIZATION IS DIAGNOSTIC & IT MAY REMAIN HIGH EVEN AFTER 2-6 MTHS OF SUCCESSFUL TREATMENT. TITRE BECOMES PROGRESSIVELY HIGH IN CASE OF NON TREATMENT OR UNSUCCESSFUL TREATMENT.
investigation.Remarks:
IN ENTERIC FEVER SPECIFIC AGGLUTININS ARE USUALLY DETECTABLE AFTER AT LEAST 7 DAYS OF FEVER.
SERA FROM NORMAL INDIVIDUALS MAY SHOW AGGLUTINATION IN TITER OF 1:80. TITER OF 1:160 OR MORE ARE SPECIFIC.
A SINGLE POSITIVE RESULT HAS LESS SIGNIFICANCE THAN A RISING AGGLUTININ TITER.
A RISE IN THE TITER OF ALL THREE "H" AGGLUTININ IS RESULT OF TAB VACCINATION.

investigation.Name: MONTOUX TEST
investigation.Description: IT IS A TYPE OF ANTIGEN-ANTIBODY REACTION TO DIAGNOSE THE PRESENCE OF ANTIBODIES AGAINST TUBERCULAR BACILLI IN THE BODY. AN INDURATION OF MORE THAN 10 MM AFTER 72 HRS OF TUBERCULIN TEST WITH .1 ML OF 5 T.U. PPD SIGNIFIES POSITIVE REACTION BUT POSITIVE REACTION DOES NOT NECESSARILY SIGNIFY THE PRESENCE OF ACTIVE TUBERCULOSIS. FURTHER DIAGNOSTIC TESTS SHOULD BE DONE BEFORE DISNOSIS OF TUBERCULOSIS IS MADE.
investigation.Remarks:
DOUBTFUL REACTION : INDURATION MEASURING BETWEEN 5 & 9 MM

NEGATIVE REACTION : INDURATION OF LESS THAN 5 MM.THIS INDICATES LACK OF HYPERSENSTIVITY TO TUBERCULOPROTEIN & TUBERCULAR INFECTION IS HIEGHLY UNLIKELY. 
IT SHOULD BE NOTED THAT REACTIVITY TO TUBERCULIN MAY BE DEPRESSED OR SUPPRESSED FOR AS LONG AS FOUR WEEKS BY VIRAL INFECTION, LIVE VIRUS VACCINES OR BY THE ADMINISTRATION OF CORTICOSTEROIDS. MALNUTRITION MAY ALSO HAVE THE SIMILAR EFFECTS.

investigation.Name: IGG MYCOBACTERIUM TUBERCULOSIS
investigation.Description:
IT IS A FORM OF IMMUNOGLOBULIN THAT OCCUR LATE IN AN INFECTIOUS PROCESS.
THIS TEST IS DONE & IS POSITIVE ONLY WHEN THE TUBERCULOSIS IS THERE IN THE BODY FOR SOME TIME & LATENT PULMONARY OR EXTRA PULMONARY INFECTION
investigation.Remarks:
AFFECTED BY PRIOR BCG VACCINATION, EXPOSURE TO NONTUBERCULAR MYCOBACTERIA.
ANTIBODIES MAY NOT DEVELOP IN ANERGIC PATIENTS.

investigation.Name: IGM MYCOBACTERIUM TUBERCULOSIS
investigation.Description:
IGM IS A FORM OF IMMUNOGLOBULIN WHICH OCCURS EARLY IN AN INFECTIOUS PROCESS.
THIS TEST IS DONE TO ASCERTAIN A RECENTLY ACQUIRED  TUBERCULAR INFECTION OF THE BODY & LATENT PULMONARY OR EXTRA PULMONARY INFECTION
investigation.Remarks:
AFFECTED BY PRIOR BCG VACCINATION, EXPOSURE TO NONTUBERCULAR MYCOBACTERIA.
ANTIBODIES MAY NOT DEVELOP IN ANERGIC PATIENTS.

investigation.Name: THYROGLOBULIN
investigation.Description: THE TEST IS HELPFUL IN THE DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSIS OF HYPERTHYROIDISM & IN MONITORING THE COURSE OF DIFFERENTIATED OR METASTATIC THYROID CANCER. NOT USEFUL IN THE DIAGNOSIS OF THYROID CANCER. LEVELS DECREASE FOLLOWING SUCCESSFUL INITIAL TREATMENT & IN RECURRENCE OF METASTASIS, THE LEVELS WILL RISE AGAIN. LACK OF SENSTIVITY & SPECIFICITY LIMITS THE VALUE OF THIS TEST.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Differentiated thyroid carcinomas (papillary, follicular), Graves disease, nontoxic goiter( BENIGN ADENOMA), SUCACUTE THYROIDITIS, OCCURRENCE OF METASTASIS AFTER INITIAL TREATMENT( THYROID CANCER).
Decreased : Hypothyroidism, TREATMENT WITH testosterone, steroids, phenytoin, THYROTOXICOSIS FACTITIA, INFANTS WITH GOITROUS HYPOTHYROIDISM.

investigation.Name: DENGU SEROLOGY (IGG & IGM)
investigation.Description:
DENGUE SPECIFIC IGM ANTIBODIES IS COMMONLY USED METHOD FOR DETECTING AN ACTIVE PRIMARY DENGUE INFECTION. IGM ANTIBODIES ARE TYPICALLY PRODUCED AT DETECTABLE LEVELS BY DAY 5 AFTER THE ONSET OF FEVER OR SYMPTOMS.
IN SECONDARY DENGUE INFECTIONS, IGG ANTIBODIES ARE PRODUCED AT VERY HIGH LEVELS. SOME MAY PRODUCE DETECTABLE LEVELS AT DAY 3 AFTER ONSET OF FEVER BUT IDEAL WINDOW FOR DETECTION IS DAY 6 ONWARDS.

investigation.Name: ACTH STIMULATION TEST
investigation.Description: THIS DETECTS ADRENAL INSUFFUCIENCY AFTER CORTROSYN ADMINISTRATION. CORTROSYN IS A SYNTHETIC SUBUNIT OF ACTH THAT EXIBITS THE FULL CORTICOSTEROID-STIMULATING EFFECTS OF ACTH IN HEALTHY PERSONS. FAILURE TO RESPOND IS AN INDICATION OF ADRENAL INSUFFUCUENCY. THIS SCREENING TEST IS LESS TIME CONSUMING AND CAN BE DONE ON AN OUTPATIENT BASIS.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Addison's disease (primary adrenal hypofunction), ectopic ACTH production (small [oat] cell lung carcinoma, pancreatic islet cell tumors, thymic tumors, renal cell carcinoma, bronchial carcinoid), Cushing's disease (pituitary adenoma), congenital adrenal hyperplasia (adrenogenital syndrome). 
Decreased : Adrenal adenoma or carcinoma, nodular adrenal hyperplasia, pituitary insufficiency, corticosteroid use.

investigation.Name: STOOL ROUTINE
investigation.Description: ROUTINE STOOL EXAMINATION IS DONE FOR DETECTING ANY KIND OF PARASITIC INFESTATION, FOR EVIDENCE OF ANY BLOOD LOSS FROM THE GUT OR MALABSORPTION STUDY.

investigation.Name: STOOL FOR OCCULT BLOOD
investigation.Description:
AN AVERAGE HEALTHY PERSON PASSES UPTO 2.0 ML OF BLOOD PER 150 GMS OF STOOL. 
NORMALLY ITS VALUE IS NEGATIVE IN THE STOOL.
investigation.Remarks: Positive : Any GI tract ulcerated lesion (ulcer, carcinoma, polyp, diverticulosis, inflammatory bowel disease), hemorrhoids, telangiectasias, drugs that cuase GI irritation (eg, NSAIDs) swallowed blood, ingestion of rare red meat, certain foods (horseradish, turnips) (vitamin C [>500 mg/d], antacids may result in false-negative test).

investigation.Name: URINE PREGNANCY TEST
investigation.Description: IN THIS URINARY HCG LEVELS ARE MEASURED WHICH IS PRODUCED BY VERY YOUNG PLACENTAL TROPHOBLAST. THE TEST BECOMES POSITIVE AFTER 5 - 7 DAYS OF CONCEPTION & BECOMES NEGATIVE AFTER 3 - 4 DAYS OF DELIVERY.

investigation.Name: URINE R/M
investigation.Description:
IN URINE ROUTINE EXAMINATION WE DETERMINE FOLLOWING PROPERTIES : COLOR, ODOR, TURBIDITY, SPECIFIC GRAVITY, PH, GLUCOSE, KETONES, PROTEIN, BILIRUBIN, UROBILINOGEN, NITRITE, BLOOD, LEUKOCYTES  & OTHER CONSTITUENTS IN THE MICROSCOPIC EXAMINATION.
VOLUME - NORMAL URINE OUTPUT - 600 ML - 2500 ML
SPECIFIC GRAVITY - IT IS THE MEASUREMENT OF KIDNEYS ABILITY TO CONCENTRATE URINE.
URINE PH - THE PH IS AN INDICATOR OF THE RENAL TUBULES ABILITY TO MAINTAIN NORMAL HYDROGEN ION CONCENTRATION IN THE PLASMA & EXTRACELLULAR FLUID.KIDNEYS MAINTAIN ACID-BASE BALANCE PRIMARILY THROUGH RESORPTION OF SODIUM & TUBULAR SECRETION OF HYDROGEN & AMONIUM IONS.
BLOOD IN URINE - MAY BE DUE TO RENAL OR GENITO-URINARY DISEASE LIKE UTI, NEPHRITIS, LUPUS NEPHRITIS, URINARY TRACT OR RENAL TUMOURS, CALCULI,MALIGNANT HYPERTENSION, GLOMERULONEPHRITIS, PYELONEPHRITIS, TRAUMA, POLYCYSTIC KIDNEY DISEASE, LEUKEMIA, THROMBOCYTOPENIA & STRENUOUS EXERCISE.
URINE ALBUMIN - IT CAN BE AN IMPORTANT INDICATOR OF RENAL DISEASE. NORMALLY THERE IS NO PROTEIN OR ONLY TRACE OF PROTEIN IN THE URINE. 
URINE GLUCOSE - GLUCOSE IS PRESENT IN GLOMERULAR FILTRATE & IS REABSORBED BY THE PROXIMAL CONVOLUTED TUBULES. THE BLOOD LEVEL AT WHICH TUBULAR RESORPTION STOPS IS TERMED, RENAL THRESHOLD WHICH FOR GLUCOSE IS 160-180 MG/ML. IF THE BLOOD GLUCOSE LEVELS EXCEED RESORPTION CAPACITY OF THE TUBULES, GLUCOSE WILL APPEAR IN THE URINE.
KETONE BODIES - KETONES RESULT FROM THE METABOLISM OF FATTY ACIDS & FAT.WHEN CARBOHYDRATE METABOLISM IS ALTERED, AN EXCESSIVE AMOUNT OF KETONES ARE FORMED. 
URINE WBC - NORMALLY NO WBCS ARE PRESENT IN THE URINE.
URINE BILIRUBIN - ELEVATED AMOUNTS APPEAR WHEN NORMAL DEGRADATION CYCLE IS DISRUPTED BY OBSTRUCTION OF THE BILE DUCT OR WHEN THE INTEGRITY OF LIVER IS DAMAGED. AN EARLY SIGN OF HEPATO-BILIARY DYSFUNCTION.
URINE CAST - ITS PRESENCE INDICATES RENAL DISEASE
WHEATHER IT IS GRANULAR, HYALINE, RBC OR WBC CAST.
URINE CRYSTALS - SOME CRYSTALS ARE PRESENT IN THE URINE NORMALLY & QUANTITY MAY DEPEND ON URINE PH AND DIET.
OTHER URINE FINDINGS - URINE SHREDS WHICH CONSIST OF MUCUS, PUS & EPITHELIAL CELLS. OTHER SUSTANCES MAY BE YEAST, TRICHOMONAS, SPERMATOZOA, VEGETABLE FIBRES, PARASITES & MEAT FIBRES.
investigation.Remarks:
VOLUME INCREASED - DIABETIC KETOACIDOSIS, DIABETES MALLITUS, DIABETES INCIPIDUS, RENAL TUBULAR NECROSIS, NEUROTIC DISEASE.
VOLUME DECREASED - GLOMERULONEPHRITIS, RENAL ISCHAEMIA, DEHYDRATION, OBSTRUCTIVE PATHOLOGY, CARDIAC INSUFFICIENCY.
SPECIFIC GRAVITY - INCREASED IN DIABETES MALLITUS, NEPHROSIS, DEHYDRATION, INCREASED SECRETION OF ADH, CHF, TOXAEMIA OF PREGNANCY.
DECREASED - NEPHROTIC SYNDROME, CHRONIC RENAL FAILURE, DIABETES INSIPIDUS, GLOMERULONEPHRITIS, PHELONEPHRITIS.
URINE PH - INCREASED > 7 :- UTI CAUSED BY UREA SPLITTING BACTERIA( PROTEUS & PSEUDOMONAS ), RENAL TUBULAR ACIDOSIS, CHRONIC RENAL FAILURE, METABOLIC ACIDOSIS, RESPIRATORY ALKALOSIS INVOLVING HYPERVENTILATION & POTASSIUM DEPLETION.
PH REDUCED < 7 :- METABOLIC ACIDOSIS, DIABETIC KETOSIS, DIARRHOEA, STARVATION, UREMIA, UTI CAUSED BY E.COLI, RESPIRATORY ACIDOSIS, RENAL TUBERCULOSIS, PYREXIA.
URINE PROTEIN - PRESENT IN GLOMERULONEPHRITIS, SLE, MALIGNANT HYPERTENSION, AMYLOIDOSIS, DIABETES MALLITUS, NEPHROTIC SYNDROME, POLYCYSTIC KIDNEY DISEASE, WILSON DISEASE, FANCONI SYNDROME ETC, ETC.
URINE SUGAR - PRESENT IN DIABETES, ENDOCRINE DISORDERS, PANCREASE & LIVER DISEASES, BRAIN INJURY, STROKE.
URINE KETONE BODIES - INCREASED IN DIABETES & FASTING, GLYCOGEN STORAGE DISEASE, HIGH-FAT DIETS, PROLONGED VOMITINGS & DIARROHEA, FEVER, PREGNANCY, HYPERTHYROIDISM.
URINE WBC - PRESENT IN INFECTION.
URINE BILIRUBIN - RAISED IN LIVER DISEASES & HEPATITIS, BILIARY TRACT DISEASES, SEPTICEMIA, HYPERTHYROIDISM.
URINE CAST :- PRESENT IN GLOMERULONEPHRITIS, RENAL TUBULAR DISEASE, PYELONEPHRITIS, AC. BACTERIAL ENDOCARDITIS, GOODPASTURE SYNDROME, MALIGNANT HYPERTENSION.
URINE CRYSTALS - ITS PRESENCE MAY INDICATE CHANCES OF URINARY CALCULUS.

investigation.Name: URINE ALBUMIN( 24 HRS ) FOR MALE
investigation.Description: IF MORE THAN TRACE OF ALBUMIN IS FOUND PERSISTENTLY, A QUANTITATIVE 24-HR EVALUATION OF PROTEIN EXCRETION IS NECESSARY.
investigation.Remarks: INCREASED IN DIABETICS IN DIABETIC NEPHROPATHY, HYPERTENSION, GENERAKISED VASCULAR DISEASE & PREECLAMPSIA.

investigation.Name: URINE FOR MICROALBUMIN
investigation.Description:
MICROALBUMINURIA IS AN INCREASE IN URINARY ALBUMIN THAT IS BELOW THE DETECTABLE RANGE OF THE STANDARD PROTEIN DIPSTICK TEST. IT IS NOT A DIFFERENT FORM OF ALBUMIN. MICROALBUMINURIA OCCURS LONG BEFORE CLINICAL PROTEINURIA BECOMES EVIDENT.
THIS TEST HAS BECOME STANDARD FOR THE SCREENING, MONITORING & DETECTION OF DETERIORATING RENAL FUNCTION IN DIABETIC PATIENTS.
investigation.Remarks: INCREASED IN DIABETICS IN DIABETIC NEPHROPATHY, HYPERTENSION, GENERAKISED VASCULAR DISEASE & PREECLAMPSIA.

investigation.Name: T3
investigation.Description: IT IS THE TEST OF CHOICE IN THE DIAGNOSIS OF T3 THYROTOXICOSIS. IT IS NOT THE SAME AS THE T3 UPTAKE TEST THAT MEASURES THE UNSATURATED TBG IN SERUM. IT CAN ALSO BE VERY USEFUL IN THE DIAGNOSIS OF HYPERTHYROIDISM.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Hyperthyroidism, T3 thyrotoxicosis, pregnancy, exogenous T4, any cause of increased TBG, such as oral estrogen or pregnancy, ACUTE THYROIDITIS, EARLY THYROID FAILURE, IODINE DEFICIENCY GOITER.

Decreased : Hypothyroidism and erthyroid sick state, any cause of decreased TBG, STARVATION & STATE OF NUTRITION SUBACUTE NONTHYROID ILLNESS ( 70% ).

investigation.Name: T4
investigation.Description:
TOTAL T4 LEVEL IS A GOOD INDEX OF THYROID FUNCTION WHEN THE TBG IS NORMAL. THE INCREASE IN TBG LEVELS NORMALLY SEEN IN PREGNANCY & WITH OESTROGEN THERAPY INCREAES TOTAL T4 LEVELS. THE DECREASE OF TBG LEVELS IN PERSONS RECEIVING ANABOLIC STEROIDS, IN CHRONIC LIVER DISEASE & IN NEPHROSIS DECREASES THE TOTAL T4 LEVELS.
THIS TEST IS COMMONLY DONE TO RULE OUT HYPOTHYROIDISM, HYPERTHYROIDISM & AS GUIDE TO DRUG TREATMENT IN HYPO OR HYPERTHYROIDISM.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Hyperthyroidism, exogenous thyroid hormone, estrogens, pregnancy, severe illness, euthyroid sick syndrome, ACUTE THYROIDITIS, HEPATITIS, LIVER DISEASE, LYMPHOMA.

investigation.Name: TSH
investigation.Description: IT IS THE SINGLE MOST SENSITIVE TEST FOR PRIMARY HYPOTHYROIDISM. TSH IS PRODUCED BY PITUTARY GLAND & ITS RELEASE IS STIMULATED BY THYROTROPIN RELEASING HORMONE FROM THE HYPOTHALAMUS & NEGATIVE FEEDBACK BY SERUM T3 & T4 LEVELS.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Hypothyroidism, THYROTROPIN PRODUCING TUMOURS( ECTOPIC TSH SECRETION FROM LUNG , BREAST TUMOURS), HASHIMOTO THYROIDITIS, THYROTOXICOSIS DUE TO PITUTARY TUMOR, HYPOTHYROID PATIENTS RECEIVING INSUFFICIENT THYROID REPLACEMENT HORMONE OR THYROID HORMONE RESISTANCE, TSH ANTIBODIES, ASSAY ARTIFACTS, TSH SECRETING PITIUTARY TUMOR.

Decreased : Hyperthyroidism. Less than 1% of hypothyroidism is from pituitary or hypothalamic disease resulting in a decreased TSH. SECONDARY & TERTIARY HYPOTHYROIDISM, TREATED GRAVES DISEASE, EUTHYROID SICK DISEASE, OVERPLACEMENT OF THYROID HORMONE IN THE TREATMENT OF HYPOTHYROIDISM, 1ST TRIMESTER OF PREGNANCY ( DUE TO HCG SECRETION ), IN RESPONSE TO CERTAIN MEDICINES ( HIGH DOSES OF GLUCO - CORTICOIDS OR DOPAMINE ).

investigation.Name: SERUM TESTOSTERONE ( TOTAL ) FOR MALE
investigation.Description:
TESTOSTERONE EXISTS IN SERUM AS BOTH UNBOUND( FREE ) FRACTION & BOUND FRACTION TO ALBUMIN. 
TESTOSTERONE MEASUREMENTS IN MEN ASSESS HYPOGONADISM, PITUTARY GONADOTROPIN FUNCTION, IMPOTENCY & CRYPTORCHIDISM. IN WOMEN THIS IS USEFUL IN DETECTING OVARIAN TUMORS & HIRSUTISM. THIS TEST MAY BE PART OF A FERTILITY WORKUP IN ASSOCIATION WITH CHRONIC ANOVULATION CAUSED BY POLYCYSTIC OVARY SYNDROME.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Adrenogenital syndrome, HYPERTHYROIDISM, SYNDROME OF ANDROGEN RESISTANCE, QADRENAL TUMORS, PRECOCIOUS PUBERTY & ADRENAL HYPERPLASIA IN BOYS.
ovarian stromal hyperthecosis, polycystic ovaries, menopause, ovarian tumors.

Decreased : Some cause of impotence, hypogonadism, hypopituitarism, Klinefelter's syndrome,ORCHIDECTOMY, CIRRHOSIS LIVER, DOWN SYNDROME, DELAYED PUBERTY.

investigation.Name: SERUM CORTISOL ( 8.00 A.M. )
investigation.Description:
CORTISOL ( HYDROCORTISONE ) IS A GLUCOCORTICOID OF ADRENAL CORTEX & AFFECTS METABOLISM OF PROTEINS, CARBOHYDRATES & LIPIDS. CORTISOL STIMULATES GLUCOGENESIS BY THE LIVER, INHIBITS THE EFFECT OF INSULIN & DECREASES THE RATE OF GLUCOSE USE BY THE CELLS. IN HEALTH, THE SECRETION RATE OF CORTISOL IS HIGHER IN THE EARLY MORNING & LOWER IN THE EVENING. THIS VARIATION IS LOST IN PATIENTS WITH CUSHING SYNDROME & IN PERSONS UNDER STRESS.
THIS TEST EVALUATES ADRENAL HORMONE FUNCTION. SUPPRESSION & STIMULATION TEST CAN ALSO BE DONE. CORTISOL SUPPRESSION TEST ( DEXAMETHASONE ) SCREENS FOR CUSHING SYNDROME & IDENTIFIES DEPRESSED PERSONS WHO ARE LIKELY TO RESPOND TO ANTIDEPRESSANTS OR SHOCK THERAPY. IT IS BASED ON THE FACT THAT ACTH PRODUCTION IS SUPPRESSED IN HEALTHY PERSONS AFTER A LOW DOSE OF DEXAMETHASONE BUT NOT IN PERSONS WITH CUSHING SYNDROME OR IN SOME DEPRESSED PERSONS.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Adrenal adenoma, adrenal carcinoma, Cushing's disease, nonpituitary ACTH-producing tumor, steroid therapy, oral contraceptives, HYPERTHYROIDISM, STRESS (TRAUMA, SURGERY), CARCINOMA ( EXTREEM ELEVATION IN THE MORNING & NO VARIATION IN THE EVENING), OBESITY.

Decreased : Primary adrenal insufficiency (Addison's disease), congenital adrenal hyperplasia, Waterhouse-Friderichsen syndrome, ACTH deficiency, HYPOTHYROIDISM ( HYPOPITUITARISM).

investigation.Name: URINE CULTURE TEST
investigation.Description:
CULTURE TEST HELPS IN ISOLATING THE OFFENDING AGENT AS WELL AS IN TREATING THE DISEASE BY FINDING OUT THE MOST SUITABLE DRUG AFTER SENSTIVITY TEST RESULTS.
THIS TEST CAN BE PERFORMED ON ANY BODY FLUID OR DISCHARGE TO KNOW THE OFFENDING AGENT & THE DRUGS TO WHICH IT IS SENSITIVE.

investigation.Name: FNAC
investigation.Description: FINE NEEDLE ASPIRATION CYTOLOGY ( FNAC ) IS USEFUL IN CASES WHERE BIOSY IS NEEDED TO CONFIRM THE DIAGNOSIS. IT IS MINIMAL INVASIVE TECHNIQUE TO TAKE OUT TISSUE SAMPLE FROM THE DISEASED AREA WHICH CAN BE SEEN UNDER MICROSCOPE AFTER STAINING FOR HISTOPATHOLOGY.

investigation.Name: X-RAY CHEST P.A. VIEW
investigation.Description: DONE TO SEE ANY LUNG DISEASE OR INJURY OR ANY CHEST WALL INJURY OR BONE DISEASE. CHEST X-RAY IS DONE TO EVALUATE CARDIAC SIZE & CARDIAC DISEASES ALSO.

investigation.Name: X-RAY  KUB
investigation.Description: DONE TO SEE FOR ANY RENAL STONE OR ANY STONE IN THE KIDNEYS, URETERS OR URINARY BLADDER REGION.

investigation.Name: X-RAY PELVIS A . P. VIEW
investigation.Description: DONE TO SEE BONE INJURY OR DISEASE

investigation.Name: X-RAY CHEST APICOGRAM
investigation.Description: DONE TO SEE ANY LUNG DISEASE ENVOLVING APICES.

investigation.Name: X-RAY BARIUM SWALLOW
investigation.Description: DONE TO DIAGNOSE HIATUS HERNIA, EOSOPHAGITIS, EOSOPHAGEAL TUMOURS OR ACHALASIA CARDIA LIKE EOSOPHAGEAL ABNORMALITIES.

investigation.Name: X-RAY BARIUM FOLLOW THROUGH
investigation.Description: DONE TO DIAGNOSE OBSTRUCTIVE, INFLAMMATORY OR STRUCTURAL PATHOLOGY OF INTESTINES.

investigation.Name: X-RAY BARIUM UPPER G.I.
investigation.Description: DONE TO SEE FOR ANY UPPER G.I. DISORDERS LIKE EOSOPHAGITIS, EOSOPHAGEAL TUMOURS, GASTRIC ULCERS, GASTRITIS, PYLORIC STENOSIS, GASTRIC TUMOURS ETC, ETC.
investigation.Remarks: WITH THE ADVENT OF MORE SOFISTICATED INVESTIGATIONS LIKE ENDOSCOPY IT IS LOOSING ITS VALUE.

investigation.Name: X-RAY CHEST LAT. VIEW
investigation.Description: DONE TO SEE ANY LUNG DISEASE OR INJURY OR ANY CHEST WALL INJURY OR BONE DISEASE. CHEST X-RAY IS DONE TO EVALUATE CARDIAC SIZE & CARDIAC DISEASES ALSO.

investigation.Name: X-RAY ABDOMEN ERECT VIEW
investigation.Description: DONE TO DIAGNOSE INTESTINAL PERFORATION OR OBSTRUCTION.

investigation.Name: X-RAY HAND A.P. & OBLIQUE VIEW
investigation.Description: DONE TO SEE ANY BONY INJURY OR DISEASE

investigation.Name: X-RAY I.V.P.
investigation.Description: DONE TO SEE KIDNEY FUNCTION , ANY OBSTRUCTIVE RENAL PATHOLOGY OR ANY SPACE OCCUPYING OR ERODING LESION.

investigation.Name: X-RAY LEG A.P. & LAT. VIEW
investigation.Description: DONE TO SEE LEG BONE INJURY OR DISEASE

investigation.Name: X-RAY LUMBO-SACRAL SPINE A.P. & LAT. VIEW
investigation.Description: DONE TO SEE VERTIBRAL DISEASE OR INJURY

investigation.Remarks: WITH THE ADVENT OF C.T. SCAN & M.R.I. TO DIAGNOSE INTRA CRANIAL PATHOLOGY , PLAIN X-RAY SKULL HAS LOST ITS IMPORTANCE FOR THESE INDICATIONS.

investigation.Name: ULTRA SOUND WHOLE ABDOMEN
investigation.Description: IT IS NONINVASIVE TECHNIQUE TO DIAGNOSE INTRAABDOMINAL PATHOLOGIES. IT IS QUITE SENSITIVE AND SAFE DURING EARLY PREGNANCY ALSO.

investigation.Name: ULTRA SOUND LOWER ABDOMEN
investigation.Description: IT IS NONINVASIVE TECHNIQUE TO DIAGNOSE INTRAABDOMINAL PATHOLOGIES.

investigation.Name: ULTRA SOUND K.U.B.
investigation.Description: IT IS A NONINVASIVE INVESTIGATION WHICH CAN HELP TO EVALUATE INTRA-ABDOMINAL CONDITIONS RELATED TO KIDNEYS, URETERS AND URINARY BLADDER

investigation.Name: ULTRA SOUND OBSTETRICS
investigation.Description: THE ULTRASOUND HAS BECOME A VERY IMPORTANT TOOL TO DIAGNOSE ANY POSSIBILITY OF CONGENITAL PHYSICAL DEFORMITY IN THE FETUS , CEPHALOPELVIC DISPROPORTION, HYDROAMNIOS, MULTIPLE PREGNANCIES OR OTHER ABNORMALITIES IN THE PREGNANT WOMEN.

investigation.Name: STRESS MYOCARDIAL PERFUSION SCAN
investigation.Description: MYOCARDIAL PERFUSION STATUS CAN BE KNOWN DURING STRESS BY THIS TEST.

investigation.Name: MUGA ( MULTIGATED ACQUISITION IMAGING ) STRESS
investigation.Description: THE PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THIS TEST IS TO PROVIDE AN EJECTION FRACTION DURING CARDIAC CYCLE. ONCE INJECTED THE DISTRIBUTION OF RADIOLABELED RBC IS IMAGED BY SYNCHRONIZATION OF THE RECORDING OF CARDIAC IMAGES WITH THE ECG. THIS TECHNIQUE PROVIDES A MEANS OF OBTAINING INFORMATION ABOUT CARDIAC OUTPUT, END-SYSTOLIC VOLUME, END-DIASTOLIC VOLUME, EJECTION FRACTION, EJECTION VELOCITY & REGIONAL WALL MOTIONS OF THE VENTRICLES. THIS PROCEDURE MAY ALSO BE PERFORMED AS STRESS TEST. MUGA SCANS ARE NOT OFTEN PERFORMED ON CHILDREN.
investigation.Remarks: INDICATIONS : CHF, CHANGES IN VENTRICULAR FUNCTION DUE TO INFARCTION, PERSISTENT ARRHYTHMIAS FROM POOR VENTRICULAR FUNCTION, REGURGITATION DUE TO VALVULAR DISEASE, VENTRICULAR ANEURYSM FORMATION.

investigation.Name: CAPTOPRIL INTERVENTION RENOGRAM
investigation.Description:
RENOGRAM IS PERFORMED TO STUDY THE FUNCTION OF KIDNEYS & TO DETECT RENAL PARENCHYMAL OR VASCULAR DISEASE OR DEFECTS IN EXCRETION.
TEST IS DONE IN CHILDREN SAFELY BECAUSE OF NONTOXIC NATURE OF THE RADIOPHARMACEUTICALS IN COMPARISION TO CONTRAST MEDIUMS. PROCEDURE IS DONE TO EVALUATE HYDRONEPHROSIS, OBSTRUCTION, REDUCED RENAL FUNCTION, RENAL TRAUMA, UTI & POST RENAL TRANSPLANTATION.

investigation.Name: RENAL DMSA SCAN
investigation.Description: A RADIOTRACER( TECHNITIUM ) IS INJECTED INTO THE VEIN & RENAL SCAN IS TAKEN BY GAMMA CAMERA WHICH GIVES INFORMATION ABOUT THE SIZE, POSITION & SHAPE OF KIDNEYS & WHETHER THERE ARE SCARS IN THE KIDNEYS FROM A PREVIOUS INFECTIONS.

investigation.Name: BONE SCAN
investigation.Description: FOR FINDING OUT BONY METASTASIS OR BONE TUMOURS

investigation.Name: MRI CARDIAC WITH CINE MRI
investigation.Description: USED TO SEE CARDIAC FUNCTION AND ABNORMALITIES

investigation.Name: RENAL DOPPLER
investigation.Description: TO SEE FOR RENAL ARTRY STENOSIS OR OTHER VESSELS ABNORMALITIES. IT PROVIDES A COLOR CODED DEPICTION OF SELECTED BLOOD FLOW PARAMETERS

investigation.Name: COLOR DOPPLER ABDOMINAL
investigation.Description: A PHENOMENON THAT ACCOMPANIES MOVEMENT, THE DOPPLER EFFECT, CAN BE COMBINED WITH DIAGNOSTIC ULTRA SOUND IMAGING TO PRODUCE DUPLEX SCANS. DUPLEX SCANS PROVIDE ANATOMIC VISUALIZATION OF BLOOD VESSELS & A GRAPHIC REPRESENTATION OF BLOOD FLOW CHARACTERISTICS. FLOW DIRECTION, VELOCITY & THE PRESENCE OF FLOW DISTURBANCES CAN RADILY BE ASSESSED.
investigation.Remarks: USED TO DIAGNOSE PORTAL HYPERTENSION, AORTA AND OTHER LARGE VESSELS PATENCY OR ABNORMALITIES.

investigation.Name: ALPHA FETOPROTEIN ( ADULT )
investigation.Description:
ALPHA-FETOPROTEIN IS A GLYCOPROTEIN PRODUCED BY FETAL LIVER, YOLK SAC & INTESTINAL EPITHELIUM. DISAPPEARS FROM BLOOD SOON AFTER BIRTH & IS NOT PRESENT IN HEALTHY INDIVIDUALS. ( < 5.8 IU / ML ). 
IT DIAGNOSE & MONITOR AFP TUMORS, FOLLOW UP FOR THERAPY OF TESTICULAR, OVARIAN & PRIMARY LIVER TUMORS. IT IS USED WITH HCG.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Hepatoma (hepatocellular carcinoma), testicular tomor (embryonal carcinoma, malignant teratoma), neural tube defects (in mother's serum [spina bifida, anencephaly, myelomeningocele], fetal death, multiple gestations, ataxia-telagiectasia, some cases of benign hepatic diseases (alcoholic cirrhosis, hepatitis, necrosis). YOLK SAC OVARIAN TUMORS, TERATOCARCINOMA, GASTRIC, PANCREATIC, COLONIC, BREAST, RENAL, LUNG CANCERS. OTHER NON CANCEROUS DISEASES ARE G.I. TUMORS, PRIMARY BILIARY CIRRHOSIS, PARTIAL HEPATECTOMY, WISKOTT-ALDRICH SYNDROME, MULTIPLE PREGNANCIES & ABORTION.

Decreased : Trisomy 21 (Down syndrome) in maternal serum

investigation.Name: ANGIOTENSIN CONVERTING ENZYME
investigation.Description:
ANGIOTENSIN I IS PRODUCED BY THE ACTION OF RENIN ON ANGIOTENSINOGEN. ANGIOTENSIN I-CONVERTING ENZYME ( ACE ) CATALIZES THE CONVERSION OF ANGIOTENSIN I TO THE VASOACTIVE PEPTIDE ANGIOTENSIN II. ANGIOTENSIN I IS CONCENTRATED IN THE PROXIMAL TUBULES.
THIS TEST IS USED PRIMARILY TO EVALUATE THE SEVERITY & ACTIVITY OF SARCOIDOSIS.SERIAL DETERMINATIONS MAY BE HELPFUL IN FOLLOWING THE CLINICAL COURSE OF THE DISEASE WITH STEROID TREATMENT. IT IS ALSO USED IN THE INVESTIGATION OF GAUCHER DISEASE.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : SARCOIDOSIS, GAUCHER DISEASE, LEPROSY, AC & CHR BRONCHITIS, CONNECTIVE TISSUE DISORDERS, AMYLOIDOSIS, PULMONARY FIBROSIS, FUNGAL DISEASES & HISTOPLASMOSIS, UNTREATED HYPERTHYROIDISM, DIABETES MALLITUS, PSORIASIS, PREMATURE INFANTS WITH RESPIRATORY DISTRESS SYNDROME.

DECREASED : FOLLOWING PREDNISOLONE TREATMENT OF SARCOIDOSIS, ADVANCED LUNG NEOPLASMS, STARVATION.

investigation.Name: BLOOD SUGAR ( AFTER MEALS )
investigation.Description: GLUCOSE IS FORMED FROM CARBOHYDRATE DIGESTION & CONVERSION OF GLYCOGEN TO GLUCOSE BY THE LIVER. THE TWO HORMONES THAT DIRECTLY REGULATE BLOOD GLUCOSE LEVELS ARE GLUCAGON & INSULIN. GLUCAGON ACCELERATES GLYCOGEN BREAKDOWN IN THE LIVER & CAUSES THE BLOOD GLUCOSE LEVELS TO RISE. INSULIN INCREAES CELL MEMBRANE PERMEABILITY TO GLUCOSE, TRANSPORT GLUCOSE INTO CELLS, STIMULATES GLYCOGEN FORMATION, & REDUCE BLOOD GLUCOSE LEVELS.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : DIABETES MALLITUS, CUSHING SYNDROME, AC. EMOTIONAL OR STRESS SITUATION, PHEOCHROMOCYTOMA, ACROMEGALY, GIGANTISM, PITUITARY ADENOMA, HEMOCHROMATOSIS, PANCREATITIS, GLUCAGONOMA, ADVANCED LIVER DISEASE, CHR. RENAL DISEASE, WERNICKES ENCEPHALOPATHY.

DECREASED : PANCREATIC ISLET CELL CARCINOMA, EXTRAPANCREATIC STOMACH TUMORS, ADDISON DISEASE, , HYPOPITUITARISM, HYPOTHYROIDISM, ACTH DEFICIENCY, STARVATION,LIVER DAMAGE ( ALCOHOLISM, ARSENIC POISONING, CHLOROFORM POISONING), PREMATURE INFANTS, ENZYME DEFICIENCY DISEASES ( GALACTOSEMIA, INHERITED MAPLE SYRUP DISEASE, VON GIERKES SYNDROME), INSULIN OVERDOSE, REACTIVE HYPOGLYCEMIA.

investigation.Name: BLOOD CULTURE
investigation.Description: BLOOD CULTURE IS DONE IN INFECTIOUS DISEASES TO FIND OUT THE OFFENDING ORGANISM PRESENT IN THE BODY.
investigation.Remarks: RESULT OF CULTURE DEPENDS ON MANY FACTORS LIKE PRIOR USE OF ANTIBIOTICS, TIME OF SAMPLE COLLECTION & CULTURE MEDIUM USED FOR GROWING ORGANISM.

investigation.Name: STOOL CULTURE
investigation.Description: STOOL CULTURE IS DONE TO FIND OUT THE OFFENDING ORGANISM PRESENT IN THE GUT.

investigation.Name: LATEX AGGLUTINATION TEST FOR ANTIBODY TO VI ANTIGEN
investigation.Description: IT IS MORE SPECIFIC & SENSITIVE THAN WIDAL TEST ( SENSTIVITY >95% ) WITH VERY LOW RATES OF FALSE NEGATIVITY
investigation.Remarks: POSITIVE - TYPHOID FEVER

investigation.Name: ANTI-THYROGLOBULIN ANTIBODIES
investigation.Description: ANTI-THYROGLOBULIN ANTIBODIES ARE DIRECTED AGAINST THE GLYCOPROTEIN THYROGLOBULIN LOCATED IN THE THYROID FOLLICLES
investigation.Remarks: INCREASED : HASHIMOTO THYROIDITIS, GRAVES DISEASE, THYROID CARCINOMA, IDIOPATHIC MYXEDEMA, PERNICIOUS ANAEMIA, SLE, R. ARTHRITIS, SJOGREN SYNDROME, SUBACUTE THYROIDITIS, NON TOXIC NODULAR GOITER.

investigation.Name: SERUM IRON ( FEMALE )
investigation.Description:
TOTAL IRON BINDING CAPACITY ( TIBC ) CORELATES WITH SERUM TRANSFERRIN, BUT THE RELATION IS NOT LINEAR. A SERUM IRON TEST WITHOUT A TIBC AND TRASNSFERRIN DETERMINATION HAS VERY LIMITED VALUE EXCEPT IN CASES OF IRON POISONING. TRANSFERRIN SATURATION IS A BETTER INDEX OF IRON SATURATION; IT IS EVALUATED AS FOLLOWS :
TRANSFERRIN SATURATION % = S. IRON * 100 / TIBC
 THE COMBINED RESULTS OF TRANSFERRIN, IRON & TIBC TESTS ARE HELPFUL IN THE DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSIS OF ANEMIA, IN THE ASSESSMENT OF IRON DEFIICIENCY ANEMIA & IN THE EVALUATION OF THALASSEMIA, SIDEROBLASTIC ANEMIA & HEMOCHROMATOSIS.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : hemochromatosis, hemosiderosis caused by excessive iron intake, excess destruction or decreased production of erythrocytes, liver necrosis, HEMOLYTIC ANEMIA, ESPECIALLY THALASSEMIA, PERNICIOUS ANEMIA IN RELAPSE; IRON OVERLOAD SYNDROME, MULTIPLE TRANSFUSIONS, INAPPROPRIATE IRON THERAPY, VIT B6 DEFICIENCY, LEAD POISONING, AC. LEUKEMIA, NEPHRITIS.

Decreased : Iron deficiency anemia, nephrosis (loss of iron-binding proteins), normochromic anemia of chronic diseases and infections, ACUTE & CHRONIC BLOOD LOSS, LATE PREGNANCY.

investigation.Name: SERUM CORTISOL ( 4.00 P.M. )
investigation.Description:
CORTISOL ( HYDROCORTISONE ) IS A GLUCOCORTICOID OF ADRENAL CORTEX & AFFECTS METABOLISM OF PROTEINS, CARBOHYDRATES & LIPIDS. CORTISOL STIMULATES GLUCOGENESIS BY THE LIVER, INHIBITS THE EFFECT OF INSULIN & DECREASES THE RATE OF GLUCOSE USE BY THE CELLS. IN HEALTH, THE SECRETION RATE OF CORTISOL IS HIGHER IN THE EARLY MORNING & LOWER IN THE EVENING. THIS VARIATION IS LOST IN PATIENTS WITH CUSHING SYNDROME & IN PERSONS UNDER STRESS.
THIS TEST EVALUATES ADRENAL HORMONE FUNCTION. SUPPRESSION & STIMULATION TEST CAN ALSO BE DONE. CORTISOL SUPPRESSION TEST ( DEXAMETHASONE ) SCREENS FOR CUSHING SYNDROME & IDENTIFIES DEPRESSED PERSONS WHO ARE LIKELY TO RESPOND TO ANTIDEPRESSANTS OR SHOCK THERAPY. IT IS BASED ON THE FACT THAT ACTH PRODUCTION IS SUPPRESSED IN HEALTHY PERSONS AFTER A LOW DOSE OF DEXAMETHASONE BUT NOT IN PERSONS WITH CUSHING SYNDROME OR IN SOME DEPRESSED PERSONS.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Adrenal adenoma, adrenal carcinoma, Cushing's disease, nonpituitary ACTH-producing tumor, steroid therapy, oral contraceptives, HYPERTHYROIDISM, STRESS (TRAUMA, SURGERY), CARCINOMA ( EXTREEM ELEVATION IN THE MORNING & NO VARIATION IN THE EVENING), OBESITY.

Decreased : Primary adrenal insufficiency (Addison's disease), congenital adrenal hyperplasia, Waterhouse-Friderichsen syndrome, ACTH deficiency, HYPOTHYROIDISM ( HYPOPITUITARISM).

investigation.Name: BUN
investigation.Description:
UREA FORMS IN THE LIVER & ALONG WITH CO2, CONSTITUTES THE FINAL PRODUCT OF PROTEIN METABOLISM. 
THE TEST FOR BUN, WHICH MEASURES THE NITROGEN PORTION OF UREA, IS USED AS AN INDEX OF GLOMERULAR FUNCTION IN THE PRODUCTION & EXCRETION OF UREA. RAPID PROTEIN CATABOLISM & IMPAIRMENT OF KIDNEY FUNCTION WILL RESULT IN INCREASE BUN LEVELS. IN CHRONIC RENAL DISEASE, THE BUN LEVEL CORRELATES BETTER WITH SYMPTOMS OF UREMIA THAN DOES THE SERUM CREATININE.
investigation.Remarks:
INCREASED : RENAL FAILURE (INCLUDING DRUG-INDUCED FROM AMINOGLYCOSIDES, NSAIDS), PRE-RENAL AZOTEMIA (DECREASED RENAL PERFUSION SECONDARY TO CHF, SHOCK, VOLUME DEPLETION), POSTRENAL (OBSTRUCTION), GI BLEEDING, STRESS, DRUGS (ESPECIALLY AMINOGLYCOSIDES), HIGH PROTEIN DIET.

DECREASED : STARVATION, LIVER FAILURE (HEPATITIS, DRUGS), LATE PREGNANAY, INFANCY, NEPHROTIC SYNDROME, OVERHYDRATION, MALABSORPTION, ACROMEGALY & HIGH CARBOHYDRATE/LOW PROTEIN DIET.

investigation.Name: LH ( FEMALE - FOLLICULAR PHASE )
investigation.Description:
LH & FSH ARE GLYCOPROTEIN PITUITARY HORMONES PRODUCED & STORED IN THE ANTERIOR PITUITARY. LH ACTS ON LEYDIG CELLS OF GONADS.
THIS TEST MEASURES THE GONADOTROPHIC HORMONE LH AND MAY HELP DETERMINE WHETHER A GONADAL DEFICIENCY IS OF PRIMARY ORIGIN OR IS DUE TO INSUFFICIENT STIMULATION BY THE PITUITARY HORMONES. MEASURING THE LEVELS OF FSH & LH IS OF VALUE IN STUDING CHILDREN WITH ENDOCRINE PROBLEMS RELATED TO PRECOCIOUS PUBERTY. 
IN THE CASE OF ANOVULATORY FERTILITY PROBLEM, THE PRESENCE OR ABSENCE OF THE MIDCYCLE PEAK CAN BE ESTABLISHED THROUGH A SERIES OF DAILY BLOOD SAMPLES.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : (Hypergonadotropic >40 IU/L) postmenopausal, surgical or radiation castration, ovarian or testicular failure, polycystic ovaries, COMPLETE TESTICULAR FEMINIZATION SYNDROME.

Decreased : (Hypogonadotropic < 40 IU/L prepubertal) hypothalamic and pituitary dysfunction, kallmann's syndrome, LHRH analogue therapy.

CHILDREN - 0.00 TO 0.90 IU / L

investigation.Name: FSH ( FEMALE - FOLLICULAR PHASE )
investigation.Description:
LH & FSH ARE GLYCOPROTEIN PITUITARY HORMONES PRODUCED & STORED IN THE ANTERIOR PITUITARY. FSH ACTS ON GRANULOSA CELLS OF THE OVARY & SERLOTI CELLS OF THE TESTIS. NORMALLY FSH INCREASES OCCUR AT EARLIER STAGES OF PUBERTY, 2-4 YRS BEFORE LH REACHES COMPARABLE LEVELS.
THIS TEST MEASURES THE GONADOTROPHIC HORMONE LH AND MAY HELP DETERMINE WHETHER A GONADAL DEFICIENCY IS OF PRIMARY ORIGIN OR IS DUE TO INSUFFICIENT STIMULATION BY THE PITUITARY HORMONES. MEASURING THE LEVELS OF FSH & LH IS OF VALUE IN STUDING CHILDREN WITH ENDOCRINE PROBLEMS RELATED TO PRECOCIOUS PUBERTY. 
IN THE CASE OF ANOVULATORY FERTILITY PROBLEM, THE PRESENCE OR ABSENCE OF THE MIDCYCLE PEAK CAN BE ESTABLISHED THROUGH A SERIES OF DAILY BLOOD SAMPLES.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : (hypergonadotropic > 40 IU/L) postmenopausal, surgical castration, gonadal failure, gonadotropin-secreting pituitary adenoma, TURNER SYNDROME( OVARIAN DYSGENESIS), HYPOPITUITARISM,SHEEHANS SYNDROME, PRECOCIOUS PUBERTY, KLINEFELTER SYNDROME, ALCOHOLISM, MWNOPAUSAL & MENSTRUAL DISORDERS, HYPOGONADISM, COMPLETE TESTICULAR FEMINIZATION SYNDROME( END ORGAN RESISTANCE TO ANDROGENS DUE TO ANDROGEN RECEPTOR DEFECTS), CONGENITAL ABSENCE OF TESTICLES, 46XY/XO, 47XYY KARYOTYPES, MUTATION IN FSH RECEPTOR GENE IN MEN, CRYPTORCHIDISM, DISORDERS OF ANDROGEN BIOSYNTHESIS, SERTOLI- CELL-ONLY SYNDROME, MYOTONIC DYSTROPHY, INFECTIONS LIKE MUMPS, RADIATION, ANTINEOPLASTIC AGENTS, CHEMICALS LIKE DIBROMODICHLOROPROPANE, GLUCOCORTICOIDS, KETOCONAZOLE, SURAMIN, TRAUMA, TORTION TESTIS, CHR SYSTEMIC DISEASES LIKE CIRRHOSIS, CHR RENAL FAILURE, AIDS, AUTOIMMUNE DAMAGE DUE TO ANTISPERM ANTIBODIES, IDIOPATHIC, GONADOTROPH ADENOMAS

Decreased : (Hypogonadotropic < 5 IU/L) prepubertal, hypothalamic and pituitary dysfunction, pregnancy, FEMINIZING & MASCULANIZING OVARIAN TUMORS WHEN FSH PRODUCTION IS INHIBITED BECAUSE OF INCREASED OESTROGEN SECRETION, KALLMANN SYNDROME, PITUITARY LH OR FSH DEFICIENCY, NEOPLASM OF TESTES OR ADRENAL GLANDS THAT INFLUENCE SECRETION OF OESTROGENS OR ANDROGENS, POLYCYSTIC OVARIAN DISEASE, HEMOCHROMATOSIS, ANOREXIA, ISOLATED IDIOPATHIC HYPOGONADOTROPIC HYPOGONADISM.

investigation.Name: GLUCOSE TOLERANCE TEST ( III - 60 MTS )
investigation.Description: IN HEALTHY INDIVIDUALS THE INSULIN RESPONSE TO A LARGE ORAL GLUCOSE DOSE IS ALMOST IMMIDIATE. IT PEAKS IN 30 MTS TO 60 MTS & RETURNS TO NORMAL LIMITS WITHIN 3 HRS WHEN SUFFICIENT INSULIN IS PRESENT OT METABOLISE THE GLUCOSE INGESTED. THE TEST SHOULD BE PERFORMED ACCORDING TO THE WHO GUIDELINES USING GLUCOSE LOAD CONTAINING THE EQUIVALENT OF 75 - 100 GMS OF ANHYDROUS GLUCOSE DISSOLVED IN WATER OR OTHER SOLUTION.
investigation.Remarks:
Increased : Diabetes mellitus, Cushing's acromegaly, increased epinephrine (injection, pheochromocytoma, stress, burns, etc), acute pancreatitis, ACTH administration, spurious increase caused by drawing blood from a site above an IV line containing dextrose, elderly patients, pancreatic glucagonoma, drugs (glucocorticoids, some diuretics).

Decreased : Pancreatic disorders (pancreatitis, islet cell tumors), extrapancreatic tumors (carcinoma of the adrenals, stomach), hepatic disease (hepatitis, cirrhosis, tumors), endocrine disorders (early diabetes, hypothyroidism, hypopituitarism), functional disorders (after gastrectomy), pediatric problems (prematurity, infant of a diabetic mother, ketotic hypoglycemia, enzyme diseases), exogenous insulin, oral hypoglycemic agents, malnutrition, sepsis.

investigation.Name: G6PD ( QUANTITATIVE - CHILDREN )
investigation.Description: G6PD IS A SEX LINKED DISORDER. THE MAJOR VARIANTS OCCUR IN SPECIFIC ETHNIC GROUPS. WITH SOME VARIANTS THERE IS CHRONIC LIFELONG HAEMOLYSIS, BUT MORE COMMONLY THE CONDITION IS ASYMPTOMATIC & RESULTS ONLY IN SUSCEPTIBILITY TO ACUTE HAEMOLYTIC EPISODES, WHICH MAY TRIGGERED BY CERTAIN DRUGS, INGESTION OF FAVA BEANS, OR VIRAL OR BACTERIAL INFECTIONS. G6PD HAEMOLYSIS IS ASSOCIATED WITH FORMATION OF HEINZ BODIES IN PERIPHERAL RBCS.
investigation.Remarks:

investigation.Name: PET ( POSITRON EMMISION TOMOGRAPHY ) IMAGING TUMOR
investigation.Description:
PET IMAGING INVOLVESTHE COMBINED USE OF POSITRON-EMITTING RADIONUCLIDES AND EMISSION CT. PET TECHNOLOGY GENERATES HIGH RESOLUTION IMAGES OF BODY FUNCTION & METABOLISM. PET USES RADIOPHARMACEUTICALS THAT ARE BASIC ELEMENTS OF BIOLOGIC SUBSTANCES LIKE CARBON-11, NITROGEN-13, OXYGEN-15 & FLUORINE-18. THESE RADIONUCLIDES USED IN PET IMAGING HAVE VERY SHORT HALF LIFE ( 2 MTS TO 2 HRS. ). IN THIS WAY NORMAL & ABNORMAL BIOLOGIC FUNCTION OF CELLS AND ORGAN CAN BE DETERMINED. IT PRODUCES IMAGES OF MOLECULAR LEVEL PHYSIOLOGIC FUNCTION, INCLUDING GLUCOSE METABOLISM, OXYGEN UTILIZATION, BLOOD FLOW & TISSUE PERFUSION. THE RADIOPHARMACEUTICAL DOSE IS INJECTED WHICH EMITS RADIOACTIVITY IN THE FORM OF POSITRON, WHICH ARE DETECTED & TRANSFORMED INTO A VISUAL DISPLAY BY COMPUTER.
PET IMAGING IS USED FOR SEVERAL PURPOSES. NEOPLASTIC CELLS, INFECTION & VIABLE MYOCARDIUM
 ARE HYPERMETABOLIC & APPEAR TO HAVE AFFINITY THAT RESULTS IN HIGH CONTRAST OF THE RADIONUCLIDES IN THE AREA.
PET IMAGING IS USEFUL IN ONCOLOGY, NEUROLOGY & CARDIOLOGY. HOWEVER THE TECHNIQUE IS APPLICABLE TO ALL PARTS OF THE BODY FOR DIAGNOSIS, DISEASE STAGING & MONITORING THERAPY. UNLIKE MRI OR CT , PET PROVIDES PHYSIOLOGIC, ANATOMIC & BIOCHEMICAL DATA.
IN ONCOLOGY, PET HAS PROVED USEFUL IN SEVERAL AREAS, INCLUDING THE DIAGNOSIS OF PULMONARY NODULES, THE DIFERENTIATION OF PANCREATIC CANCER FROM MASS FORMING PANCREATITIS, & THE DIAGNOSIS OF BREAST CANCER IN SELECTED CASES OF MAMMOGRAPHY & BIOPSY FAILURE. PET IMAGING IS USED FOR THE INITIAL PREOPERATIVE STAGING OF CANCER INVOLVING THE LUNGS, LIVER, COLON, BREAST. HEAD & NECK AS WELL AS IN MELANOMA & LYMPHOMAS. investigation.Name: TREADMILL STRESS TEST ( TMT )
investigation.Description:
Exercise cardiac stress testing (ECST) is the most widely used cardiac stress test. The patient exercises on a treadmill according to a standardized protocol, with progressive increases in the speed and elevation of the treadmill (typically changing at three minute intervals). During the ECST, the patient's electrocardiogram (EKG), heart rate, heart rhythm, and blood pressure are continuously monitored. If a coronary arterial blockage results in decreased blood flow to a part of the heart during exercise, certain changes may be observed in the EKG, as well as in the response of the heart rate and blood pressure. 

The accuracy of the ECST in predicting significant CAD is variable, depending in part on the "pre-test likelihood" of CAD (also known as Bayes' theorem). In a patient at high risk for CAD (e.g.: advanced age, multiple coronary risk factors), an abnormal ECST is very predictive of the presence of CAD (over 90% accurate). However, a relatively normal ECST may not reflect the absence of significant disease in a patient with the same risk factors. Conversely, in a low- risk patient, a normal ECST is very predictive of the absence of significant CAD (over 90% accurate), but an abnormal test may not reflect the true presence of CAD (so-called "false-positive ECST"). The ECST may either miss the presence of significant CAD, or be a false-positive test, due to a variety of cardiac circumstances, which may include: 

An abnormal EKG at rest, which may be due to abnormal serum electrolytes, abnormal cardiac electrical conduction, or certain medications, such as digitalis; 
Heart conditions not related to CAD, such as mitral valve prolapse or hypertrophy (increased size) of the heart; or 
An inadequate increase in the heart rate and/or blood pressure during exercise.

investigation.Name: RADIONUCLEIDE STRESS TEST
investigation.Description: Radionucleide stress testing involves injecting a radioactive isotope (typically thallium or cardiolyte) into the patient's vein after which an image of the patient's heart becomes visible with a special camera. The radioactive isotopes are absorbed by the normal heart muscle. Nuclear images are obtained in the resting condition, and again immediately following exercise. The two sets of images are then compared. During exercise, if a blockage in a coronary artery results in diminished blood flow to a part of the cardiac muscle, this region of the heart will appear as a relative "cold spot" on the nuclear scan. This cold spot is not visible on the images that are taken while the patient is at rest (when coronary flow is adequate). Radionucleide stress testing, while more time-consuming and expensive than a simple ECST, greatly enhances the accuracy in diagnosing CAD.

investigation.Name: STRESS ECHOCARDIOGRAPHY
investigation.Description: Another supplement to the routine ECST is stress echocardiography. During stress echocardiography, the sound waves of ultrasound are used to produce images of the heart at rest and at the peak of exercise. In a heart with normal blood supply, all segments of the left ventricle (the major pumping chamber of the heart) exhibit enhanced contractions of the heart muscle during peak exercise. Conversely, in the setting of CAD, if a segment of the left ventricle does not receive optimal blood flow during exercise, that segment will demonstrate reduced contractions of heart muscle relative to the rest of the heart on the exercise echocardiogram. Stress echocardiography is very useful in enhancing the interpretation of the ECST, and can be used to exclude the presence of significant CAD in patients suspected of having a "false-positive" ECST.

investigation.Name: CORONARY ANGIOGRAPHY
investigation.Description:
During a coronary angiogram, a small catheter (a thin hollow tube with a diameter of 2-3 mm) is inserted through the skin into an artery in either the groin or the arm. Guided with the assistance of a fluoroscope (a special x-ray viewing instrument), the catheter is then advanced to the opening of the coronary arteries, the blood vessels supplying blood to the heart. Next, a small amount of radiographic contrast (a solution containing iodine, which is easily visualized with x-ray images) is injected into each coronary artery. The images that are produced are called the angiogram. 

Angiographic images accurately reveal the extent and severity of all coronary arterial blockages. Coronary angiography is performed with the use of local anesthesia and intravenous sedation, and is generally not terribly uncomfortable. The procedure takes approximately 20-30 minutes. After the procedure, the catheter is removed and the artery in the leg or arm is either sutured, "sealed," or treated with manual compression to prevent bleeding. There is a small risk of serious complications from coronary angiography, as it is an "invasive" test, but in the hands of experienced physicians, this risk is quite small (well below one per cent). In appropriate patients, the therapeutic information learned from the angiogram is far more valuable than the relatively small risk of the procedure. For patients with severe angina or myocardial infarction, or those who have markedly abnormal noninvasive tests for CAD, the angiogram also helps the doctor select the optimal treatment, which may include medications, balloon angioplasty, coronary stenting, atherectomy ("roto-rooter"), or coronary bypass surgery. The coronary angiogram is the only test which allows the precise quantification of the extent and severity of CAD to optimally make these treatment decisions.

investigation.Name: ANTI-THYROID PEROXIDASE ANTIBODIES TEST(TPO)
investigation.Description:
A test done to detect autoantibodies directed against thyroid peroxidase (TPO), an enzyme in the thyroid gland that is very important to the production of thyroid hormones. TPO is found in thyroid follicle cells where it catalyzes the iodination of T4 and T3 in the biosynthesis of thyroid hormones. 
Autoantibodies to thyroid peroxidase (abbreviated TPOAb) are produced by the body itself. TPOAb can attack the thyroid and damage thyroid function. These antibodies are present in a high proportion (70% to 90%) of people with chronic thyroiditis. These antibodies are also present in lesser numbers of people with other thyroid diseases. Other autoimmune disorders such as Sjögren syndrome, lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, and pernicious anemia are sometimes positive for TPOAb. Small numbers (around 3%) of people may have TPOAb show no evidence of disease. The chance of having TPOAb is greater in females and increases with age.
investigation.Remarks: PRESENT : CHRONIC THYROIDITIS ( 70 - 90 % ), SJOGREN SYNDROME, LUPUS, RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS, PERNICIOUS ANEMIA.
